formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 1. Correction: an integer gluing defect is not a propagation residue
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 1. Correction: an integer gluing defect is not a propagation residue

For an arbitrary INTEGER encoding tuple (c,h), define

sigma(c,h)=(h0-c0+c2, h1-c1+c3) mod 3.

The earlier inverse theorem states exactly that sigma=0 iff an integer raw X6 preimage exists. Consequently sigma(c(x),h(x))=0 for EVERY native-chart input x, including every nonzero k(s,t) hidden from c. Any map from raw Z^6 back into Z^6 remains compatible when both observers are recomputed from the same output. Hence sigma alone CANNOT classify physical survival/absorption. A nonzero sigma is an incompatible encoded state, stale/mismatched readout, or an implementation issue unless a separate physical interpretation is proved. Do not discard nonzero compatible kernel data as automatically absorbed.

For the formal observer update of T on arbitrary integer encodings, direct substitution gives sigma' = (-sigma1,sigma0) mod3. This is an encoding check, not a native defect orbit. Weighted rational sums are not individual raw Cells; sigma is not applied to them as though they were integer addresses.

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 2. The actual labelled BRC extension
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 2. The actual labelled BRC extension

Retain each positive path as (root source, full choice word, raw X6, positive CWM, complete T/U/branch-event history). Root source and path identity are distinct. Alternatives are disjoint by (root,choice word). Serial transitions execute the existing cwm_propagate/cwm_edge and the existing T/U transform. Positive summaries execute cwm_recoalesce. Branch event B_j is not a spatial step or physical time.

Define E_p as three alternatives with normalized rational nonnegative weights p0,p1,p2 and coordinate words I,T^4,T^8. Empty-support choices are skipped; supported edges are strictly positive. No averaged coordinate is installed as a Cell. This adds branching/provenance support to the existing family; it is not an accepted new top-level BRC family.

For the declared common linear observers C=sum_b w_b*c(x_b) and H=sum_b w_b*h(x_b), serial/alternative laws imply

C(E_p P)=(p0+p1*omega+p2*omega^2) C(P), H(E_p P)=H(P), omega=alpha^4.

Proof: c(T^4 x)=omega*c(x), c(T^8 x)=omega^2*c(x), while h(T^4 x)=h(T^8 x)=h(x). Sum the path contributions. Thus a contracting visible factor is compatible with an exactly persistent hidden factor one. These equations are observer laws, not full population equality.

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 3. Equal three-route filtering is a projector only at the reduced level
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 3. Equal three-route filtering is a projector only at the reduced level

Set p0=p1=p2=1/3 and call the program E. Then C(E P)=0 and H(E P)=H(P). At the raw first-moment level its linear map is

P=(I+T^4+T^8)/3,  P x=k(h0(x),h1(x))/3.

One can verify without division that (I+T^4+T^8)x=k(h0,h1). Cyclic multiplication gives P^2=P. Also the weighted endpoint distribution after repeated E is unchanged after the first generation, by convolution of the uniform law on {I,T^4,T^8}. But after n actual branch generations, starting from one unit-weight path, CWM=(3^n,1,3^(-n)); paths and histories have NOT become identical or been erased.

P x is an integer vector iff 3 divides both h0 and h1. Even then a matching first moment is not a proof that a multipath population is one Cell. For x=e0 the E branches are e0,e4,-e2, each weight1/3; their mean is (1,0,-1,0,1,0)/3, not a divisible native Cell. They have C=0 and H=(1,0), total positive weight1 and individual squared length1.

Finite-group averaging onto invariant components is standard mathematics; see SageMath official documentation for reynolds_operator at https://doc.sagemath.org/html/en/reference/groups/sage/groups/matrix_gps/finitely_generated_gap.html . No literature-wide novelty is claimed. The contribution here is the scoped BRC application, integer-typing correction, explicit observer transport and validation for the prior X6 candidate.

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 4. A delayed common action can expose the hidden readout
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 4. A delayed common action can expose the hidden readout

For any population already filtered by E, write H=(s,t). Its first moment is k(s,t)/3. Applying the SAME U to all paths yields

C(U E P)=(2s/3,2t/3,-2s/3,-2t/3).

This is nonzero iff H is nonzero. In algebraic form it is (2/3)(s+t*alpha)(1-alpha^2). Each path still has its unchanged positive weight and raw squared length.

After any n common T actions, H rotates to J^n H, J(s,t)=(-t,s). Thus

C(U T^n E P)=unhide(J^n H),

which never vanishes for a nonzero H and has period four in n. This proves persistence under arbitrarily many model operations, NOT a physical transmission distance or an identification of n with elapsed heartbeat time.

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 5. A specific coupling creates exact observer attenuation
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 5. A specific coupling creates exact observer attenuation

Starting from E P0, repeat the two-stage program: apply U to every path, then E. On the filtered first-moment subspace,

H -> H/3, C -> 0.

Proof: h(U k(s,t)/3)=(s/3,t/3); E preserves that h and removes C. Consequently after N cycles,

H_N=3^(-N) H_0, C_N=0,
C(U P_N)=(2/3^(N+1))(h00,h01,-h00,-h01).

For e0, positive CWM remains (3^(N+1),1,3^(-(N+1))). Every actual path retains squared length1; only common linear readouts shrink. Weighted second moment remains1, whereas squared norm of the raw first moment is 3^(-(2N+1)). These are different observables, not a proven heat/energy balance. Nonzero H never becomes exactly zero in finitely many cycles.

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 6. Complete classification of the 32 even sign masks generated by T/U
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 6. Complete classification of the 32 even sign masks generated by T/U

Conjugates T^k U T^(-k) flip adjacent pairs of axes. Choosing five adjacent-pair generators along the six-cycle with one edge removed gives all 32 even sign masks exactly once: edge subsets on a tree have distinct vertex parity boundaries, and every even subset is such a boundary. This is a statement about this chosen coordinate model, not the entire native rotation group.

For a generated diagonal sign mask D=diag(eps0,...,eps5), each eps_j=+/-1 and product eps_j=1, the filtered transfer is

H'=(lambda_even H0,lambda_odd H1),
lambda_even=(eps0+eps2+eps4)/3,
lambda_odd=(eps1+eps3+eps5)/3.

Proof: apply D to k(H)/3 and use h's alternating coordinate sums; final E preserves h. Each factor is in {1,-1,1/3,-1/3}. A triple with uniform signs preserves magnitude; mixed signs contract by1/3. The index partition here is induced by T, not a universal grouping of native axes.

Within the EVEN masks: 2 masks preserve both magnitudes; 12 attenuate exactly one; 18 attenuate both. Counting: for each triple uniform patterns have one even and one odd negative-count choice, mixed patterns have three of each parity. Match the two parities to enforce even total. There are 2, 2*(1*3+1*3)=12, and 3*3+3*3=18 respectively.

Thus a repeated filter may fail to attenuate a particular residual direction even while another direction decays. The unchanged hidden direction is a precise mode-level obstruction; sigma remains zero on every actual integer branch throughout.

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 7. Finite-resolution safety is conditional on the future operation alphabet
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 7. Finite-resolution safety is conditional on the future operation alphabet

Let M=max(|h00|,|h01|). After N attenuating cycles the raw first moment has infinity norm M/3^(N+1). Any future common T/U word is a signed permutation, preserving infinity norm. Any normalized common positive mixture of such words is non-expansive by the triangle inequality. Each c coefficient is the sum/difference of two coordinates. Therefore for every finite composition of these common, source/history-blind operations,

max_j |C_future,j| <= 2M/3^(N+1).

This supplies an explicit all-future bound within that alphabet, not only a tested finite horizon. If it is smaller than a declared coefficient resolution delta, the signed LINEAR READOUT can be replaced by zero within delta; positive CWM and other required state are NOT deleted. No logarithm is needed to select N: compare 3^(N+1) to 2M/delta exactly.

The bound fails for an expanded source/path-sensitive control class. Every actual branch has x_b=V_b x0, where V_b is its recorded T/U word. Applying V_b^(-1) separately to each branch restores every coordinate to x0; T^(-1)=T^11 and U^(-1)=U. Weights, multiplicity and history survive. The aggregate C returns to c(x0) even after arbitrary many attenuating cycles. This is conditional mathematical reversibility, not a claim that the required physical controls exist or are cheap.

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 8. Cell/gate typing: a bounded source-backed bridge restriction
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 8. Cell/gate typing: a bounded source-backed bridge restriction

The exact Source euler_rotation_refinement.py, blob55e12f7ffb68a5b241f5d6323f5fde118de2716a, explicitly provides cell_gate_cycle=(C0,G0,...,C5,G5), successor and phase_kind. Hence a previous keyword-search failure did NOT establish absent incidence structure or absent finite transition labels.

At its first refinement level, a one-position successor switches cell/gate type; a two-position successor preserves it. If a purported bridge maps a Cell-only orbit to Cell-labelled incidence states and commutes with one-position successor, type preservation gives a contradiction on the very next step. An extra transition/gate state, a weakened type requirement, or an even-step bridge is required. This is an exact limitation of that proposed type-preserving bridge, not a proof against all native realizations. The bare APIs still do not supply a force-derived, full-X6, triadic-incidence-preserving F satisfying Phi F=T Phi. That stronger bridge remains OPEN, not declared absent repository-wide.

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 1. Full-X6 update induces, rather than assigns, phase
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 1. Full-X6 update induces, rather than assigns, phase

Let x=(a0,a1,a2,a3,a4,a5) in the raw Z^6 chart relative to a chosen Cell. Define

T(x)=(-a5,a0,a1,a2,a3,a4).

It permutes signed primitive generators, is bijective and preserves L_E(x)^2=sum(a_j^2). Direct composition gives T^6=-I, T^12=I and (T^3)^2=-I. The orbit of e0 proves exact order twelve. This is an algebraic relation, not a new native angle definition.

Encode x by f_x(t)=sum(a_j*t^j) in Z[t]/(t^6+1). Multiplication by t is exactly T. Factor

t^6+1=(t^2+1)(t^4-t^2+1).

Take the first-quadrant root alpha of Phi_12, so alpha^6=-1, and set rho12(x)=f_x(alpha). Therefore rho12(Tx)=alpha*rho12(x), derived from the raw rule. The exact coefficient output is

c=(a0-a4,a1-a5,a2+a4,a3+a5),

and T sends c to (-c3,c0,c1+c3,c2).

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 2. Kernel, repair and complete integer image
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 2. Kernel, repair and complete integer image

Irreducibility of Phi_12 makes coefficient equality exact. Setting c=0 gives, and is equivalent to,

ker(rho12)={(s,t,-s,-t,s,t):s,t in Z}.

This is two hidden integer degrees of freedom within X6, not extra space. Every T power preserves this kernel, so the differences are invisible to this observer under T alone.

Let beta^2=-1 and rho4(x)=f_x(beta)=h0+h1*beta, with

h0=a0-a2+a4; h1=a1-a3+a5.

T sends h to (-h1,h0). The distinct evaluation at beta may be embedded with beta=alpha^3; it is not the same evaluation as f(alpha). On the kernel h=(3s,3t).

The image of x -> (c,h) consists EXACTLY of integer tuples satisfying

h0-c0+c2 == 0 (mod 3), h1-c1+c3 == 0 (mod 3).

Necessity follows because these expressions are 3a4,3a5. For sufficiency put s=(h0-c0+c2)/3 and t=(h1-c1+c3)/3; then the unique inverse is

x=(c0+s,c1+t,c2-s,c3-t,s,t).

Thus the image has index nine in Z^4 x Z^2. The divisions recover integers; no Cell is divided. The rank statement concerns this additive encoding, not arbitrary nonlinear coding or a bit-complexity lower bound.

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 3. Coordinate intervention reveals the hidden data
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 3. Coordinate intervention reveals the hidden data

Define U(x)=(a0,a1,a2,a3,-a4,-a5). It preserves raw adjacency and length and U^2=I. It changes raw coordinates rather than editing free phase labels. With the above s,t, its exact output is

c'=(c0+2s,c1+2t,c2-2s,c3-2t), h'=(h0-2s,h1-2t).

Generator identities and induction prove that the joint representation preserves every finite word in {T,U}.

Witness: xA=(1,0,0,0,2,0), xB=(-1,0,2,0,0,0). In separate experiments, use the SAME source ID, one branch of positive weight one, and empty history. Both have CWM=(1,1,1), L_E^2=5 and c=(-1,0,2,0). Their h are (3,0),(-3,0). Both squared phase-readout moduli are 3.

After the SAME U, cA'=(3,0,-2,0), hA'=(-1,0), while cB'=(-1,0,2,0), hB'=(-3,0). Squared readout moduli are now 7 and 3. Every positive CWM remains (1,1,1), and every raw squared length remains 5. This is an exact observer contrast, NOT measured intensity, extra mass, energy creation or quantum entanglement.

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 4. Combined invariant and two-observation reconstruction
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 4. Combined invariant and two-observation reconstruction

Define A(c)=c0^2+c1^2+c2^2+c3^2+c0*c2+c1*c3 and B(c)=c0*c1+c1*c2+c2*c3. Algebraic conjugation yields |rho12|^2=A+B*sqrt(3). The implementation keeps the integer pair (A,B) and never evaluates sqrt(3).

Expansion of the integer definitions proves

3*L_E(x)^2=2*A(c)+h0^2+h1^2.

For xA, 2*3+9=2*7+1=15. A is not generally the whole squared phase modulus because B may be nonzero; neither term is physical energy.

For observer rho12 and future alphabet {T}, c is sufficient. For {T,U}, it is not. Safe elimination depends on the specified observer/actions, not solely on the current value.

Given exact coefficient outputs c=rho12(x), u=rho12(Ux), recover s=(u0-c0)/2, t=(u1-c1)/2, then use the unique inverse above. Compatibility requires even differences and u2=c2-2s,u3=c3-2t. Thus these two exact algebraic observations recover all raw coordinates. This does NOT assert recovery from two finite-precision numerical sensor readings or a nondisturbing physical measurement. Four integer coefficients are not a constant-bit complex measurement. No physical resource or speedup bound is proved.

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 1. Symmetry does not imply independent re-selection

Let chi be the routing sign, +1 or -1. The local update applies P^chi. Interchanging the two recipient roles conjugates P to P^-1 and must transform chi to -chi.

A time-homogeneous two-sign transition respecting this exchange symmetry has the general form

Pr(chi_next=chi)=p, Pr(chi_next=-chi)=1-p,

where 0<=p<=1. We use rational p for the exact positive BRC implementation. Symmetry leaves p undetermined. From an initially fair sign, every single-time sign marginal remains fair, including p=0 and p=1. Fair marginals do not imply independent choices.

For p=1 the initial sign is retained forever. For p=0 it alternates deterministically. For p=1/2 each next sign is fair and independent of the current sign. These are different programs even though their first contact has identical channel endpoint weights.

At every actual branch we retain (three binary channels, next sign, positive CWM, source root, complete choice/history record). Zero-weight alternatives are skipped. Contact applies the unchanged cyclic function, then the supported p/(1-p) edges execute cwm_edge and cwm_propagate. Alternatives use cwm_recoalesce. No fractional bit or negative positive-weight branch is created.

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 2. Exact local memory law
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 2. Exact local memory law

Use the previous alpha with alpha^4-alpha^2+1=0, and omega=alpha^4. The channel observer is zeta=a+omega*b+omega^2*f, evaluated after positive path transport.

Let u_r and v_r be its weighted sums conditional on the next routing sign + and -, without normalizing those subpopulations. Routing followed by the sign transition gives

u_next=p*omega*u+(1-p)*omega^2*v,
v_next=(1-p)*omega*u+p*omega^2*v.

Consequently zeta_r=u_r+v_r satisfies

zeta_(r+2)=-p*zeta_(r+1)+(1-2p)*zeta_r.

Proof: the displayed two-component transformation has trace -p and determinant 2p-1. Expanding its degree-two polynomial gives zero; applying the identity to u+v gives the recurrence. The array is a proved observer interface, not an alternative numerical state propagator.

For a fixed initial channel state with an independent fair initial sign, zeta_1=-zeta_0/2. Writing zeta_r=c_r*zeta_0:

p=1: c_r=1 for r divisible by3, otherwise -1/2.
p=0: c_r=1 for even r, otherwise -1/2.
p=1/2: c_r=(-1/2)^r.

Thus the one-contact average is the same, but retaining, reversing, or refreshing the routing choice gives three-period echo, two-period echo, or decay.

For every 0<p<1, the unit-count joint channel/sign chain has six states and both supported routing transitions. It is irreducible: arbitrary future choices reach every channel/sign state. Positive closed walks of lengths2 and3 through the same state make it aperiodic. Its column sums equal its row sums, both one, so uniform1/6 is stationary. The standard finite-chain theorem then yields joint convergence and vanishing channel difference modes. At p=0 or1 the chain instead splits into deterministic cycles. This statement is model-local and does not derive the parameter or independent branching from native dynamics.

The general role of correlated increments and retained memory is established prior art; see Cenac, Chauvin, Herrmann and Vallois, Persistent random walks, variable length Markov chains and piecewise deterministic Markov processes, arXiv:1208.3358. The new result here is the concrete BRC correspondence, witnesses and source-family composition, not a new general stochastic-process theory.

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 3. Exact uniformity can be a crossing, not equilibrium
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 3. Exact uniformity can be a crossing, not equilibrium

Choose p=2/3, begin at (a,b,f)=(0,0,1), and give the initial sign fair weights. After two contacts the joint channel/sign masses are

                 sign+     sign-
A occupied        1/9       2/9
B occupied        2/9       1/9
field occupied    1/6       1/6.

The three channel marginals are exactly (1/3,1/3,1/3), both sign marginals are1/2, and zeta_2=0. Nevertheless the next channel marginals are (5/18,5/18,4/9), with zeta_3=omega^2/6 !=0.

The different joint preparation assigning1/6 to each of the six states has the same channel and sign marginals but remains stationary. Therefore even exact channel uniformity plus an exactly fair routing marginal is not sufficient for equilibrium. Replacing their joint distribution by a product would erase the operative channel/sign correlation. This is a positive classical correlation example, not quantum entanglement.

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 4. What actual incoming information would have to supply
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 4. What actual incoming information would have to supply

For an input-relation set X with recipient-exchange involution R, an orientation selector chi:X->{+1,-1} satisfying chi(Rx)=-chi(x) exists if and only if R has no fixed point on X. Necessity follows at a fixed point; sufficiency assigns opposite signs to the two members of each orbit. The selection is not automatically canonical.

More generally, for a finite group of allowed relabellings G and a sign character epsilon, a selector with chi(gx)=epsilon(g)chi(x) exists on an orbit exactly when every stabilizer element of x has epsilon=+1. Choosing a representative proves sufficiency and an odd stabilizer proves obstruction.

An explicitly supplied orientation of three distinct incoming ports supplies the required antisymmetric sign. The candidate collision P^chi is then recipient-equivariant by RPR=P^-1. Using arbitrary numeric port names as an ordered frame would add data, not derive physical orientation. Coincident/indistinguishable input ports do not satisfy this construction. No native incoming-channel contract identifying the collision sign with the source slice-sheet variable is proved here.

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 5. Existing source orientation transport yields memory, not fresh randomness
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 5. Existing source orientation transport yields memory, not fresh randomness

The exact chirality source transports a sheet bit s along a comparison edge i->j by

s_j=s_i XOR e_ij.

Set chi=(-1)^s. Along a closed comparison path gamma, the final sign is

chi_after=(-1)^h_gamma*chi_before,

where h_gamma is the XOR of the traversed edge bits. Vertex gauge changes add endpoint bits that cancel around the closed path; h_gamma is gauge invariant.

Compose one collision P^chi with this declared closed-path transport. If h_gamma=0, repeated contacts keep the same sign and three contacts restore the channel state. If h_gamma=1, successive signs alternate, and two contacts restore the channel state because P^-chi P^chi=I. In both cases the sheet also returns at the stated contact count.

This composition was executed for all64 edge assignments, all4 source triangular faces, both initial signs and all8 channel triples. An initially fair sheet still has a fair sign at every return, yet its temporal choices are fully correlated. It is not equivalent to independently redrawing the sign, which multiplies the local channel observer by-1/2 on each contact.

This is an exact bridge between existing finite interfaces under a stated identification and a prescribed comparison path. It does not identify those paths with actual incoming native trajectories, prove the physical sign choice, or derive gate incidence from K4 chirality. The source itself preserves that distinction.

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 6. Exact closure term when route memory is omitted
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 6. Exact closure term when route memory is omitted

Write A_+ and A_- for pushforward by the unchanged synchronous shared-field maps F_+ and F_-. A persistent-routing joint distribution consists of positive measures mu_+,mu_-. Define the signed readout coordinates

mu=mu_++mu_-, nu=mu_+-mu_-,
K=(A_++A_-)/2, L=(A_+-A_-)/2.

Direct composition gives

mu_next=K*mu+L*nu,
nu_next=L*mu+K*nu.

The old fresh-choice endpoint dynamics is K*mu. It is exact when a fresh fair sign independent of the CURRENT full world is supplied at each choice, or when L*nu happens to vanish. A fair sign marginal only implies total(nu)=0; it does not remove L*nu. An initially independent fair sign gives nu_0=0, but generally nu_1=L*mu_0 is already nonzero.

These signed quantities are observer/certificate differences, not negative BRC populations. Atomic-column identities were checked against actual existing BRC updates. The unclosed term now has a specified cause: world/routing correlation.

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 7. Same global one-step kernel, same time average, different long-term dynamics
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 7. Same global one-step kernel, same time average, different long-term dynamics

For the SAME previous Q=1 shared-field rules, compare:

Fresh program: use the existing independent equal alternative at each shared-gate contact.
Persistent program: choose chi fairly ONCE in the initial preparation, retain it, and always apply F_chi.

For every one of1152 bare Q=1 states the programs have equal one-step endpoint mass distributions. They do not have equal full latent states, route histories or generally equal path counts.

Each fixed F_chi is a permutation with726 fixed states,12 cycles of length18 and6 cycles of length35. On an anchored35-state component, a field-only unit is released into one object, completes an excursion in17 updates, is handed directly to the other object for another17 updates, and is deposited back into the field on update35. Reversing chi swaps which identity travels first. The two fixed routes traverse the same35-state component in different orders.

Begin at one odd anchor g with both objects idle at g and f_g=1. For both preparations the symmetric phase samples agree at updates0..17. At update18:

Z_persistent=(alpha^g+alpha^(g+1))/2,
Z_fresh=(3alpha^g+alpha^(g+1))/4.

Thus Z_fresh-Z_persistent=(alpha^g-alpha^(g+1))/4 !=0. The fresh process has a deposit branch on this encounter; persistent routing has retained the correlation that enforces direct handoff.

The persistent symmetric phase has exact period35, with no convergence from this preparation. Its value alpha^g occurs three times in a35-block, ruling out periods1,5,7. Only two initial BRC alternatives are needed, with total1 and maximum weight1/2; histories still grow and are not erased.

Yet its finite35-sample TIME AVERAGE is exactly17alpha^g/35, because each fixed route visits every state in the anchored component once. This is the SAME value as the previous fresh program's limiting ensemble phase, whose convergence remains valid under that program's independent-choice assumption.

The distinction is decisive: equality of a first-step kernel and of a long-term/time average does not establish equality of the processes. A35-point temporal averaging operation is not the instantaneous dyadic-weight evolution used in the earlier nonattainment theorem, so there is no contradiction with that theorem.

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 1. Complete local deterministic obstruction
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 1. Complete local deterministic obstruction

At one shared gate, suppose the only local data are (a,b,f) in {0,1}^3. The field bit is invariant under object renaming R(a,b,f)=(b,a,f). A deterministic collision C is required to be bijective, preserve a+b+f, and commute with R.

There are exactly FOUR such collisions, and all keep f unchanged.

Proof: sectors of total0 and3 are fixed singletons. In sector1, R swaps100/010 and fixes001. A commuting permutation must fix the unique R-fixed state001, and can only keep or swap100/010. In sector2, R swaps011/101 and fixes110; again there are two choices. The choices are independent, giving four maps, each with f'=f. These exhaust all3!*3!=36 count-conserving permutations.

Even dropping bijectivity does not let the exactly symmetric state001 deterministically select a receiver: an R-fixed output with total1 must still be001. Thus nontrivial neutral symmetric release is impossible on this bare carrier. Distinct incident directions, extra channels, a different conservation law or other local information are outside the theorem. This is not a no-go for native physics.

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 2. Relational routing bit and positive symmetric alternatives
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 2. Relational routing bit and positive symmetric alternatives

Define P(a,b,f)=(f,a,b); P^-1(a,b,f)=(b,f,a). Then P^3=I, both preserve total, and RPR=P^-1. Neither oriented choice alone is invariant under R.

One relational binary bit chi suffices for a reversible extension:

G(x,chi)=(P^chi x,chi), R_tilde(x,chi)=(Rx,-chi).

G commutes with R_tilde; its inverse uses P^-chi. No routing distinction is insufficient by section1. The extra bit transforms under object relabelling; it is not a scalar field, an extra spatial dimension or physical spin. A single fixed value is not a free symmetric initialization.

A different, explicitly declared BRC program retains both alternatives:

K[x]=(1/2)[Px] plus (1/2)[P^-1 x].

Its endpoint kernel commutes with R. For001 its outputs are100 and010, each positive weight1/2. These are two alternative complete states, not two simultaneously excited receivers or fractional bits. Repeated K assumes a fresh independent equal-weight split at each contact; this is not a derived fundamental random law. A fixed chi across contacts is a different program.

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 3. Exact local channel-phase relaxation, with recovery boundary
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 3. Exact local channel-phase relaxation, with recovery boundary

For unit-count channel histogram v=(v_A,v_B,v_f),

K v=((v_B+v_f)/2,(v_A+v_f)/2,(v_A+v_B)/2).

Let E=(I+P+P^2)/3. Then K=E-(I-E)/2, E^2=E, hence

K^r v=E v+(-1/2)^r(I-E)v.

For v=(0,0,1), v_A=v_B=(1-(-1/2)^r)/3 and v_f=(1+2(-1/2)^r)/3. The same identity holds for bit expectations in the other conserved sectors.

For the existing alpha^4-alpha^2+1=0 and omega=alpha^4, the LOCAL CHANNEL observer zeta=v_A+omega*v_B+omega^2*v_f satisfies zeta_next=-zeta/2. Deterministic oriented routing multiplies it by omega or omega^2. This local repeated-contact experiment does not stream objects and is not the port-phase observer Z.

After r local BRC splits, CWM=(2^r,1,2^-r). Inverting each retained branch word restores the original triple. The marginal linear inverse K^-1=3E-2I has diagonal-1 and off-diagonal1. Thus the exact histogram is algebraically invertible, but no universally positive stochastic inverse exists; difference-mode errors amplify by2^r under inversion. Do not call this universal information destruction or physical dissipation.

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 4. Scheduler-free synchronous shared-field update
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 4. Scheduler-free synchronous shared-field update

A complete branch carries (n_A,n_B,b_A,b_B,f), with ONE shared field. At each gate use pre-stream occupancy: none -> identity; one object -> previous mode/field SWAP; two objects -> P or P^-1 on(b_A,b_B,f_g). Different gate sites have disjoint local data and commute. Then both objects stream by their new modes, using the existing successor.

For fixed chi, collision is a permutation at fixed positions, and streaming has inverse n_i=m_i-b_i. Therefore F_chi is a bijection on all12^2*2^8=36864 bare states. It conserves Q=b_A+b_B+sum f_g and positive BRC weight. Its inverse undoes both streams, then local collisions. Label exchange conjugates F_+ to F_-. Their equal-weight endpoint kernel is normalized, symmetric under object relabelling, and doubly stochastic on every conserved sector.

Outside same-gate contention the two routes coincide and the implementation uses one path. At contention both choices remain distinct paths even if their endpoints coincide. Endpoint mass, path count and full histories are not interchangeable.

This removes an alternating object scheduler, not the assumption of synchronous collision/stream stages. No physical simultaneous collision or clock has been derived.

Example: at g=1 with both modes0 and f_1=1, the outputs have ports(2,1),modes(1,0) or ports(1,2),modes(0,1), zero field, each weight1/2. Both have symmetric phase(alpha^2+alpha)/2; label-specific phase distinguishes them. Total positive weight remains1.

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 5. Complete Q=1 component theorem
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 5. Complete Q=1 component theorem

There are12^2*8=1152 bare Q=1 states. They partition into:

726 fixed states: field unit at g with neither object at g; count6*11^2.
12 deterministic18-cycles: idle object at one of six even Cell ports; choose moving identity in two ways.
6 closed strongly connected35-state components: one for each odd anchor g.

Each anchor component has17 states with A moving/depositing while B stays at g,17 with roles reversed, and one state with both idle at g and f_g=1. For each moving identity the17 states are12 moving positions plus5 deposits at gates other than g. No transient states remain;726+12*18+6*35=1152.

The two alternatives at a common arrival permit direct handoff or deposit and later reception. Every state in one anchor component reaches every other. Positive-weight closed walks of lengths18 and35 through the same arrival state have gcd1, proving aperiodicity. Here35 is a STATE COUNT, not a fixed Markov return period. The exact graph also has all-to-all reachability in306 steps and fails that property at305.

Since the kernel is an average of two permutations and the component is closed, uniform1/35 is stationary. Irreducibility and aperiodicity imply convergence from every normalized initial histogram in that component. The other fixed/18-cycle components do not acquire this convergence claim. This is the standard finite Markov theorem applied to a normalized BRC endpoint kernel, not physical randomness inferred from data.

A self-contained conservative bound: every306-step transition has weight at least2^-306. Set eta=35/2^306. Separating an eta fraction of the uniform kernel in each block gives TV(mu_t,uniform) <= (1-eta)^floor(t/306). This is a VERY weak sufficient bound, not an optimized mixing-time estimate. No numerical eigenvalues are used.

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 6. The Euler circle and its interior limiting mean
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 6. The Euler circle and its interior limiting mean

Every branch in an anchor-g component has one object at g and another at m. Thus

z=(alpha^g+alpha^m)/2, z-alpha^g/2=alpha^m/2.

The branch readouts remain on the same twelve-position external circle of radius1/2 centered at alpha^g/2. A positive average of different readouts need not remain on the circle; no native plane is introduced.

Over the17 states for one moving identity, the moving-port phase sum is

sum_(all12ports)alpha^n + sum_(five gates other than g)alpha^h = -alpha^g.

Both the full port sum and all-six-gate sum vanish. The35-state symmetric phase sum is18alpha^g-alpha^g=17alpha^g. Consequently

Z_limit=(17/35)alpha^g.

The stationary internal counts are E[b_A]=E[b_B]=12/35 and E[sum f_g]=11/35, preserving Q=1. Positive BRC mass stays1. Branchwise squared distance from the circle center stays1/4 even when the mean moves inside. These are not physical energy partitions or dissipation laws.

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 7. Convergence without finite exact equality
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 7. Convergence without finite exact equality

Start from ONE deterministic joint state of unit weight in an anchor component. Every finite endpoint weight is dyadic because transitions only multiply by1 or1/2 and add. A symmetric phase coefficient at time t has denominator dividing2^(t+1). But alpha^g has a coefficient +/-1 and the corresponding limiting coefficient is +/-17/35, not dyadic.

Therefore Z_t != (17/35)alpha^g for EVERY finite t, despite convergence. For one nonzero limiting coefficient,

|Z_t,j-Z_limit,j| >= 1/(35*2^(t+1)).

This weak lower bound is consistent with convergence. It is specific to the single-state/dyadic preparation; initializing the non-dyadic stationary distribution is excluded and would give equality immediately. It does not imply all natural residuals are nonzero.

Finite-resolution replacement can therefore be justified while finite exact equality cannot. Under this fixed future kernel, each coefficient deviation is bounded by twice TV distance. Path-sensitive inversion using recorded routing choices is a different operation class, and is not covered by the history-blind approximation.

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 1. 载体与BRC对应
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 1. 载体与BRC对应

选择参照Cell，路径P=(v_1,...,v_n)，每步v_a属于十二个带符号原生轴。实验全程六轴；短例只使用其中两轴，其他四分量显式为零，不称二维原生平面或完整三维切片。

BRC分支总体是按升序选取0..d个路径发生位置的索引组，各分支权重1；不是物理随机分支或概率。字母是带符号轴标签，正质量始终非负。保留输入完整字词作为来源。每个已选字母串的CWM系数记录其发生位置重数，串联用cwm_propagate，备选重合用cwm_recoalesce。

记C_d(P)[a_1...a_k]为k<=d的索引子序列系数。任何PQ中的子序列唯一拆成P内前段与Q内后段，故截断卷积C_d(PQ)=C_d(P)*C_d(Q)；系数的备选和串联遵守现有CWM法则。这是本扩展的对应证明。借用的不只是BRC名字：实际执行了冻结源码函数原码片段。未加载无关对数/除法模块，不能称全包回归。

源码：src/enterprise_math/brc_weighted.py@上述数学快照，Git blob 3f205696709e847909958a153f8fe10d3f6b70f0。入口：CWMState、CWM_ONE/ZERO、cwm_edge、cwm_propagate、cwm_recoalesce。Reuse: REUSE_EXECUTED + EXTEND_EXISTING_TOOL；新扩展尚未准入。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 2. 二阶顺序残差与串联律
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 2. 二阶顺序残差与串联律

定义z(P)=sum_a v_a；对1<=i<j<=6，定义
Omega_ij(P)=sum_{a<b}(v_ai*v_bj-v_aj*v_bi)。
这是有符号顺序计数，不是欧氏面积、能量、力或角度。实现先分别保存正、负贡献部门与完整正CWM端口系数，再取已声明的整数观察；没有用负权质量相消。

按两次发生均在P、均在Q、一次在各段分组，严格得到
Omega(PQ)=Omega(P)+Omega(Q)+z(P) wedge z(Q)，
其中(z wedge w)_ij=z_i*w_j-z_j*w_i。

于是候选二阶状态的动作乘法是
(z,Omega) star (w,Eta)=(z+w,Omega+Eta+z wedge w)。

结合律证明：c(z,w)=z wedge w满足c(z,w)+c(z+w,u)=c(w,u)+c(z,w+u)，两边均为z wedge w+z wedge u+w wedge u。该证明覆盖任意有限轴字词，不由有限枚举冒充无限证明。这里star是动作串联，不是普通数乘；BRC备选加法则是系数逐项recoalesce，并对卷积分配。

端点投影保持普通加法；单独Omega却不闭合，因为拼接时需要两个端点。省略交叉项可让人造的分量直积运算仍然结合，但它已不再等于真实字词的顺序观察；仅检查结合律并不足以验收补丁。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 3. 明确见证及六轴解释
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 3. 明确见证及六轴解释

P=(+1,+2)与Q=(+2,+1)都有z=(1,1,0,0,0,0)，但Omega_12分别为+1和-1。故不存在仅以六轴端点为输入、输出该顺序观察的函数。任何仅依赖端点的修正f(z)，包括一个平方和或对称度量修正，都不能区分两者。

L=(+1,+2,-1,-2)端点全零，Omega_12=2。1122与1212端点均为(2,2,0,0,0,0)，Omega_12分别4、2。它们是已执行的路径计数，不是材料运动实验。

一般右拼接一步+e_i给出：z'=z+e_i，Omega'_jk=Omega_jk+z_j*delta_ki-z_k*delta_ji。只有涉及轴i的五个关系通道可能变化；相应其余轴分量非零时该通道确实变化。其余五个z_j仍不变。这个精确区别是“五条关系记录受影响”，不是“五个坐标必然同时变化”。也没有导出全局即时传导、力学最小作用量或最小扰动选择律。

六轴共有15个反对称轴对记录，不是15个新增空间维度，也不是完整状态的普适最小参数数。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 4. 整数合法性与不可随意补值
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 4. 整数合法性与不可随意补值

实际轴字词的可达二阶对恰好满足Omega_ij == z_i*z_j (mod 2)。必要性：模2忽略符号和先后，所有i/j发生配对数为n_i*n_j，且n_i==z_i、n_j==z_j。充分性：先按轴编号排块实现z，该路径Omega_ij=z_i*z_j；再拼接有向四步回路，每次独立改变某一Omega_ij的±2而不改z。因此任意满足该奇偶约束的对都有有限字词实现。此实现只证明路径代数可达，不证明物理许可。

等价整数补丁坐标kappa_ij=(Omega_ij-z_i*z_j)/2具有kappa'=kappa+lambda-z_j*w_i。这依赖选择的轴排序基准；Omega形式较对称。不能随意加入不可达的残差半格。

更换端点依赖的基准Omega->Omega+f(z)，不会改变同一端点两条路径的残差差值。形式上端点余边界f(z)+f(w)-f(z+w)关于z,w对称，不能抹去非零反对称交换差2*z wedge w。非零顺序差不是仅靠一个端点函数就能消去的坐标记账差；仍不因此成为物理能量。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 5. 补丁的反例边界
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 5. 补丁的反例边界

空路径和(+1,-1)具有同(z,Omega)，但步数不同，所以二阶对不能替代全部来源。

更强见证：1221与2112有相同完整一阶、二阶带符号端口子序列系数，步数也相同；但三阶系数不同。比如模式122在前者出现1次、后者0次。因此即使保留所有二阶记录，也不能冒充任意高阶观察完整。两者的后续端点仍可相同；本见证区分的是已声明三阶观察，而非偷偷添加的物理更新。

最小充分状态必须相对观察与合法后续语言定义。对于本二阶观察及任意有限前后串联，(z,Omega)的乘法律保证精确保真；若增加步数、三阶模式、来源识别或真实内部场作用，须重新检查，不能沿用该压缩许可。

entries.title: 残差补丁 U2 接口审计：任意固定阶顺序统计不代替当前入口
entries.summary_zh: 旧U2核对两条同全部≤d阶子序列计数但末入口不同的递归字词给不同下步轴响应；任意预设固定d都不能覆盖该无限字词族。对固定线性U2未来，(source,Cell,incoming)的联合CWM映射反而充分；12端口total读出在声明下一步观察下可逆，近似误差下界随arrival质量衰减而非统一可测常数。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 1. Continuation and source boundary
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 1. Continuation and source boundary

用户继续“看看是不是需要给代数打一个残差补丁”。消费上一轮顺序扩展，不重跑其1885字词/91306断言全套，也不把候选Omega自动接为力。原程序BRC_PATCH.py位于research_notes/chatgpt_direct/20261007_residual_algebra_patch_7c2e8a/，blob e3397722b0ee88dc9810cb872a14e7889403eee5；本轮只调用其signature/readout等既有函数。

本次有来源的后续操作是既有U2 packet_router.py，位于research_notes/chatgpt_direct/20261007_cell_closure_u2_7f21d8/，blob7465f5aa16cbb8fba61ba4be80f8a6884b879c53。其README blobbd35175a2e5ca379e95a9c0b922395ce3be45ec7已明确默认40组signed incidence是候选；不是合法原生三元作用证书。本轮不改变该核、incidence、rho或占位选择律。

当前Source的INTERFACE_CERTIFICATE.md仍说明固定来源的G1/G2原生事件合法性/不可分实现、G3反作用/存储、G4时间/边界、G5占位后继缺口。准确路径：research_artifacts/mcp/RS-U2-NATIVE-OCCUPANCY-BRIDGE-20261007/MCP-1a6e3bae74c6436bae9f2b466e7042ba/94bd4acc4df02dacf568/INTERFACE_CERTIFICATE.md。该他人任务及贡献只读消费，不借CLAIM，也不把其固定来源缺口断言为全项目不存在性。

所以本结果是“既有条件电路确实读取被省略的信息”，不是原生力学已证。P000、120度PERP_E、六轴整数端点、q(z)=sum z_i^2和受保护世界观均未修改。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 2. Actual reused operation and observer
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 2. Actual reused operation and observer

十二端口p=0..11，对应+1,-1,+2,-2,...,+6,-6；next incoming为q xor 1。冻结rho=1/4，bulk每个出射边lambda=rho/12=1/48。材料处使用原表rho*K(q,p)，其中

K(q,p)=1/3 if q=p; 0 if q=-p; 1/15 if axis(q)!=axis(p).

这里incoming是朝向来路的端口，q=p表示回向来路，不冒称直行。K来自40个完整三轴包的分腿及正BRC聚合，不是本轮为制造区别设的新矩阵。每输入有120个腿支路；同端口40、异轴每有向端口8、反端口0。六轴响应由原axis_totals读出，不是材料位置。

实际调用原brc_weighted.py，blob3f205696709e847909958a153f8fe10d3f6b70f0，9635字节，SHA2564f3e356227a1c964d33a3ddae94922463ba28097a43b8d1b8f6cd9ca5615fc9f。U2加载器仅去掉两个未调用的相对导入，全部函数/类AST保留并校验；不是全包回归。旧顺序签名仍独立记录其实际BRC调用。

实验采用声明的可控单位电路seed，不把它冒充U2的各材料各12入口均分注入。一个预定材料Cell在路径终点，选中路径此前均在空Cell；整个传播始终有六轴十二方向。输入路径选定两条不同轴，可带符号，其余四分量显式零。没有原生二维平面或完整三维切片的宣称。每一步的未选同胞支路及衰减部门都作为未展开边界保留，不做后选择归一化；整个已展开树前沿的总正预算严格为1。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 3. Executed distinguishing witness
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 3. Executed distinguishing witness

正轴简写P=1221、Q=2112。从同seed出发、同一终端材料布局，二者端点均z=(2,2,0,0,0,0)，长度4，全部一/二阶带符号端口子序列CWM相等，Omega亦相等。沿选中bulk路径的arrival CWM均为(1,a,a)，a=lambda^4=1/5308416。

P最后一步+1，材料入口-1；Q最后一步+2，材料入口-2。原核的下一次散射给第1轴响应：

P: C=40, W=a/12=1/63700992, M=a/480;
Q: C=16, W=a/30=1/159252480, M=a/480.

总active响应都为a/4，另有3a/4保留衰减部门。轴1之差a/20来自不同入口列，不是浮点、近似、模型新增项或正质量相消。每单位入射响应的比较为1/12与1/30；这只是明确的比率观察，不把两条历史的实际arrival重新归一化。

比较对象是带路径标签的输入贡献及保留的边界，不是同一完整确定性初态无故产生两个不同结果；也不证明原U2固定等分注入下，无外部选择即可准备两个孤立物理态。对逐项传播和允许识别这些贡献的上下文，入口分解不能删除；对完整脉冲则按来源/Cell/入口正确聚合，不要求保留每条原始字词。

完整覆盖不同轴有向字母的120个有序(a,b)对，并检查abba/baab，均有同样的对应轴读数区分。本见证比“同端点异Omega”更强：即使保留上一轮全部二阶计数，仍漏掉原有后续操作所需的入口。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 4. All-fixed-order impossibility within the declared word/circuit family
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 4. All-fixed-order impossibility within the declared word/circuit family

设C_d(P)为上一轮的全部阶数<=d子序列CWM系数（发生位置分支权重1），不是只保留反对称Omega。取两个不同轴字母a,b，定义

U_0=a, V_0=b;
U_(n+1)=U_n V_n, V_(n+1)=V_n U_n.

命题：任意n>=1，U_n、V_n长度均2^n，C_n相等，但末字母不同。故对于任意预先固定的有限d，存在同端点、同长度、同C_d、同arrival CWM的允许路径，在同一个终端U2散射上给出不同轴响应。不存在仅靠固定阶C_d覆盖此族任意长历史的精确预测规则。

证明完全使用BRC的正系数卷积。假设C_d(U)=C_d(V)。任何长度<=d+1的模式在UV中按边界唯一拆成左前缀、右后缀。内部拆分的两段都长度<=d，因假设和标量CWM串联可交换，UV与VU的对应贡献相等；两端拆分的贡献为C_w(U)和C_w(V)，只是相互交换，recoalesce结果相等。因此C_(d+1)(UV)=C_(d+1)(VU)。d=0的空模式系数相同给出归纳起点。末字母在每轮互换，始终不同。由K的两不同轴列可区分得后半结论。

这是对全部有限n的符号证明，不是由n<=8检查外推。它使用有界阶子序列签名的特定定义，不宣称所有有限摘要都无效，也不声称同两条路径在所有阶都相同。固定最大路径长度时可以保留足够高阶而还原全字词。无限族中的每一对保持相同seed和布局；跨n的预定终点可变，或将布局平移到同一材料Cell而明确改变seed位置，不冒称固定seed/固定有限域的同一长时轨迹实验。

本递归属于Thue--Morse型k-binomial equivalence既有数学，不宣称经典新发现。Lejeune/Leroy/Rigo, Computing the k-binomial complexity of the Thue--Morse word, arXiv:1812.07330v1，官方题录/摘要已读取；摘要明确定义同<=k阶子序列重数。上述特定归纳证明在本记录自足给出；未宣称读完论文或其完整复杂度定理属于本项目新成果。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 5. A smaller operational repair can outperform ever-higher order
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 5. A smaller operational repair can outperform ever-higher order

反向实测：P=123、Q=213具有不同Omega，但端点、最后入口、arrival CWM完全相同。原核下一步全部signed-port CWM相同，继续三层同源/Cell/port传播仍逐项相同。

对于预定固定材料位置、只允许同一表的单输入线性传播，完整当前映射Phi[(source,Cell,incoming)]=CWM已足以接续：

Phi_next[b,z+d(q),-q] = recoalesce_p propagate(Phi[b,z,p], T_z(q,p)).

这是对原U2的实际复用。相同映射的一步后继相同，归纳覆盖任意有限层；无需为这个受限观察保存全部历史或Omega。若另要观察Omega，则额外保存它，不能把“不影响此算子”说成没有意义。三元整包阀门、来源联合操作、旧请求目标或未知原生力需要其它字段，12入口不是普适完整状态。

对单条路径，末字母是一个12值标签（空路径另有单位标记），不是新空间维度。对多路径混合，要保留按入口分别聚合的联合CWM，不是只记一个平均方向。若只要当前一阶total响应，可用非负12向量x；若还要C/M或来源，保留相应更强载体。

精确最小性（仅下一步12个有向端口total观察）：原核x->y是单射。令h_j=x_(j,+)+x_(j,-)，d_j=x_(j,+)-x_(j,-)，S=sum x，则

b_j=y_(j,+)+y_(j,-)=rho*(h_j/5+2S/15);
c_j=y_(j,+)-y_(j,-)=rho*d_j/3;
S'=sum y=rho*S.

所以h_j=(5b_j-(2/3)S')/rho，d_j=3c_j/rho，x_(j,+/-)=(h_j+/-d_j)/2。每个不同入口预算向量都被该观察区分，不能做非平凡合并。只有在线性数值参数化内才能进一步称rank=12；不排除等价编码，不冒称必需12个任意类型字段。只看即时六个unsigned-axis totals时，仅h可辨，不能沿用12维必要性。

36项正BRC输入（12纯端口+24明确有理混合）实际验证该观察逆关系；未执行普通矩阵求逆或谱参考。正/负差仅为保留正数据后的声明观察，不是负支路质量。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 6. Resolution boundary and scientific meaning
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 6. Resolution boundary and scientific meaning

对于U_d/V_d的实际seed，a=lambda^(2^d)，对应轴响应差Delta=a*rho/5。任何从同C_d返回同标量预测的规则，在该对输入中的最大绝对误差至少Delta/2；由|y1-y2|<=|y1-t|+|y2-t|立即证明。

Delta对每个有限d严格正，但随长度增长而衰减；没有统一正下界，不证明有限分辨率下永远可见。近似压缩可以有合法尺度/误差范围，不能把精确不可合并偷换为物理可检出性。关系深度不是时间，响应不是力、能量或材料位移。原六轴平方和读数未失败；改变的是状态充分性判断。

本轮收获：残差补丁应由后续操作的输入接口来选择，不能只按历史统计阶数堆叠。顺序关系记录有其保真范围；当前入口则是这一个现有算子的必要边界数据。真正原生作用是否读取哪个残差仍需G1/G2及其对应证明，而非本轮凭空指定。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 1. 当前问题与来源
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 1. 当前问题与来源

用户继续六轴代数残差研究。消费已有二阶顺序补丁与固定阶摘要不能替代入口的成果，不重跑旧全套。现在直接审计原生三元事件接口，不把旧U2转向响应自动提升为力学。

当前源 definitions/P000_DISCRETE_DIRECTION_TRIADIC_BALANCE_20260905.md，blob f95fd7a935ce16c875ac2756b299dfe2b7d9c8e5，明确：primitive force quantum 与空间位移不同；恰三项非零作用且 TRIADIC_CLOSURE_E 才是原子稳定；三异轴不是任意三元组都合法的证书；宏观多作用需三元分解，分解不唯一可保留。原生闭合不得偷换成欧氏向量和。X6/心跳命名当前blob ea4cb6eda83ce56fee37830bc04675ee7ea0ee4d 仍保留Z^6原始端点与q=sum z_i^2。

P000/受保护世界观与当前全局入口均按同一global snapshot核对；不变blob复用已读全文。BRC-only与残差保真约束继续适用。所有结果只约束下述明确表示法和测试语言；不是原生作用律已建立，也不是全项目无相关成果的全局断言。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 2. 定理A：任何端点保真的残差扩展都有同一个闭合障碍
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 2. 定理A：任何端点保真的残差扩展都有同一个闭合障碍

设M是动作串联幺半群，单位1，pi:M->(Z^6,+)是保单位幺半群同态。原始轴步t_(i,s)满足pi(t_(i,s))=s e_i，s属于{+1,-1}。M可包含任意多层残差，不假定交换、中心扩张、有限维或小残差。

若i,j,k互异，则任意次序的三个轴步乘积的端点为s_i e_i+s_j e_j+s_k e_k，恰有三个非零分量。因此该乘积不可能等于单位1，也不可能落在pi^{-1}(0)。加入任何仍保持该投影性质的残差坐标均不能改变这一点。

证明只用同态性质和Z^6的坐标独立性，不用外部角度。它涵盖上一轮(z,Omega) star (w,Eta)=(z+w,Omega+Eta+z wedge w)，以及任意保端点的高阶扩展。

这否定的是一种错误桥接：把每个带方向的作用量子直接等同于相同方向的空间步进，再要求三元稳定事件等于路径单位。原生作用本来就未被定义成该位移，所以这不是P000矛盾或三元平衡不可能。允许另外的作用载体、非同态有效读出、事件关系和有来源的状态更新；不能继续堆Omega来修复一个类型不匹配。

有限辅助执行：实际复用旧正BRC签名/有符号观察，完整检查20种不同轴选择、8种符号、6种次序共960字词。枚举只检查上述已证明结论的实现，不将全部160无序方向组三元组称为已获准原生事件。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 3. 定理B：把所有候选方向组三元组强行设成加法零会丢失轴信息
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 3. 定理B：把所有候选方向组三元组强行设成加法零会丢失轴信息

这是一个独立符号诊断，假设明确不同于原生公理。设g_1,...,g_6属于阿贝尔群；误将全部正向不同轴三元组赋关系g_i+g_j+g_k=0。任意i!=j可选与二者均不同的a,b，两条关系相减给g_i=g_j。因此所有轴像相同为g且3g=0。由这些关系生成的商群恰是Z/3Z：全部生成元映到1 mod3给出反向见证。它不再忠实保留六条不同轴。

再误将负轴读出设为-g_i，并让所有符号组合的不同轴三元组都等于加法零。比较只翻转一个符号的两条关系，得到2g=0。与3g=0合并得g=0，整个生成群坍缩为平凡群。

边界：负方向被设成阿贝尔逆元是此错误方案的额外假设，不是正BRC质量性质；若正反作用使用独立类型，本结论不能未经改写套用。原U2默认40组每入口的候选表从未因此获得TRIADIC_CLOSURE_E证书。本轮没有执行Smith标准形、普通矩阵/三角基准；上述推导自足。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 4. 修补目标：有效闭合事件不等于空对象
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 4. 修补目标：有效闭合事件不等于空对象

位置、单次作用发生、闭合关系、状态后继分别定型。建议原生桥的待填接口为：

Lift_E(context; f_a,f_b,f_c) -> certified event h OR unknown/rejected。

此处证书需要来源明确的作用发生、当前Cell/时间或顺序/边界、一项现行合法三元关系及其适用条件。仅有三个不同轴标签、相等响应预算、声明字符串或算术零都不构成证书。当前未提供可核验的真实Lift_E，测试程序明确禁止以调用者scope字符串宣称原生准入。

一个被证实的事件应先记录为h，不直接删除成0。若观察只关心未配对输入，已闭合事件可能读作无未配对项；但事件来源、作用分配、内部存储或后续解配/响应观察可能仍区分h与空输入。具体何时可压缩须按后续语言证明，不要求永久保存全部历史。

这里没有生成第三力，也没有声称闭合自动给出材料后继。材料更新还需要独立的F_E(current full state,event,boundary)，事件合法性证书不自动提供它。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 5. 可执行的条件接口：一次性三元事件装配
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 5. 可执行的条件接口：一次性三元事件装配

为验证代数层而非伪造原生律，冻结一个TEST_ONLY单轮资源模型：有限作用发生标识集I；外部给定的候选证书集合H；每个h指向I中三个不同发生；每个发生在本轮最多分配一次。不同时间再次作用可使用新发生标识，此约束不是材料/力永不复用。证书有效性在本轮冻结且不受其它已选事件改变；若存在产生新作用或上下文变化，必须改用完整状态转移而不能套本静态匹配。

一个分支保留(J,U,CWM)，J为选中的事件集合，U为这些事件占用的发生集合。剩余R=I\U，闭合日志J不丢失。权重是形式正分支权重，不是已测概率或能量。

定义基元乘法：若U与V不交且事件标识不重合，则(J,U)乘(K,V)=(J union K,U union V)；否则没有兼容装配基元。系数备选合并调用cwm_recoalesce，兼容串联调用cwm_propagate。每个事件因子为1+w_h[h]，所有因子相乘得到全部兼容选择。0表示无兼容证书分支，不表示正质量湮灭；1是唯一空选择，不等于0。全部输入库存始终另外保留。不兼容提案被单独列出，不后选择归一化。

结合律：三基元的任一加括号方式可兼容，当且仅当三组使用标识两两不交且事件标识不重合；成立时都输出并集。配合原CWM结合/分配律，得到有限支持正系数装配代数的结合和分配律。该乘法描述并行静态证书组合，不冒充有时间顺序的物理串联；顺序敏感的后续任务需保留执行词。

这是普通有限资源/超图匹配式结构在BRC中的接口应用，不主张新发明一般半环、Petri网或原生force lift。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 6. 新反例：局部闭合不能保证唯一整体残差
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 6. 新反例：局部闭合不能保证唯一整体残差

测试库存I={1,2,3,4,5,6}，发生标识不是坐标值。仅给定三种TEST_ONLY事件：A={1,2,3}，B={1,4,5}，C={4,5,6}，单位权重。它们是为检查接口明确指定的有限测试规则，不是宣称心跳世界恰好允许这三组。

全八个事件子集提案中，兼容的恰五个：空、A、B、C、AC。AB和BC共享发生，ABC也不兼容；原库存全部保留。

包含意义的极大装配有两个：AC分配全部六个发生，R为空；B已不能加A或C，R={2,3,6}。所以同一个固定库存和同一组局部三元规则，可以有不同的不可继续添加分支。极大不等于最大，局部闭合规则不等于最小全局残差选择律。保留B不是宣称该状态原生稳定；它只是该冻结装配库的一个终止分支。

若确立额外比较目标min |R|，本例会选择AC。但此目标仅是明示的组合优化，不是源定义自动授予的自然最小扰动定律，更不是能量最小。真动力学还需实际响应、时序、边界及选择规则。不得为了让残差最小而删掉另一个尚未获排除证明的分支。

此例也展示上下文依赖：A在完整库存可用，在已分配B的分支上不可再用；事件的三个标签和权重未变，当前发生分配改变了可执行性。仅保存“已经闭合一次”的计数不能代替记录是谁参与了闭合。若不保存J而把完成对象改成空，事件与来源信息也被提前丢失。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 1. 续接与准确范围
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 1. 续接与准确范围

用户继续“代数残差补丁”。上轮已证 Opt(PQ) 可以不等于 Opt(Opt(P)Q)，并给出可回退选择器及首次到达代价。本轮不重跑旧main、不增加新的物理偏好参数；直接构造何种附加状态能修复这个不相容。

沿用一次性三元发生装配。发生标识不是空间轴、Cell地址或力的大小。所有新定理只针对明确的有限装配/观察语言；没有将旧TEST_ONLY事件认定为原生三元作用，没有提供真实释放许可、反作用或能量代价。当前P000、残差保真契约及世界观保持不变。一次有界Lift_E源码搜索返回空，仅说明该次检索未定位证书，绝非全仓库不存在性的证明。

复用上轮check_selector.py@43f18c87ec6c4466d03835a49ae5a203176709a3，blob e2c84a17f3c9f59a28d51bd65460c48d3fc90a08。它引入的check_triad.py、packet_router.py、brc_weighted.py的blob分别为662755ef82c2f433ca57da76b4ce44d63a407612、7465f5aa16cbb8fba61ba4be80f8a6884b879c53、3f205696709e847909958a153f8fe10d3f6b70f0。本轮实际调用原TestEvent/factor/times/assemble/path_library及正CWM函数；加载了旧依赖但没有执行其main或递归求逆。依赖通过原Git blob验证，旧有限实验不作为本轮新实验重复报告。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 2. 精确接口：边界占用加事件数分层
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 2. 精确接口：边界占用加事件数分层

固定有限事件库，每个事件h有三个发生组成的支撑D_h及一个正CWM系数w_h。兼容装配J是发生不重叠的事件集合；U(J)为已分配发生。完整分支系数由原BRC串联与备选重合给出。

处理一部分事件P时，声明边界B：它包含P与所有允许的后续部分共有的发生。后续只允许添加预先给定的事件/做备选组合，不释放旧事件，不询问被隐藏的事件或来源，不依赖隐藏内态/路径。未来共享发生不能漏出B。这是操作接口，不是空间表面或新的维度。

定义精确分层表

T_B(P)[X,k] = recoalesce { coefficient(J): U(J) intersect B=X, |J|=k }.

X是边界哪些发生已占用；k是已选事件数。C/W/M均按原半环保留；缺项表示无该类兼容装配，不表示物理质量被湮灭。完整输入事件和其因子语法保留为来源及可重建依据，表本身不支持事件名敏感的观察。

若两个事件模块P、Q的事件身份不重复，且D_P intersect D_Q包含于同一个B，则

T_B(PQ)[X,k] = sum_{X1 disjoint X2, X1 union X2=X; k1+k2=k}
                   T_B(P)[X1,k1] times T_B(Q)[X2,k2].

sum/times分别是CWM的recoalesce/propagate。证明：每个全局选择唯一拆成前后事件选择；边界外没有共用发生，所以兼容性等价于X1、X2不交。事件数相加；所有来源支路通过原分配律重合。因此等式覆盖任意有限输入，而不由枚举外推。三部分组合可行当且仅当三组边界占用两两不交，结果为并集和分数层数之和，故结合律成立；备选分配律同理。实现拒绝未声明的隐藏重叠和重复模块事件ID。

表保真限于声明的边界/分数/CWM观察及这些正向组合，不是完整状态普适压缩。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 3. 修复Opt：只在相同X内取最高k
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 3. 修复Opt：只在相同X内取最高k

令Top_B(T)在每个X内只保留最高的k及该层所有并列CWM系数。则在上述正向语言中：

Top_B(T_P * T_Q) = Top_B(Top_B(T_P) * Top_B(T_Q)).

证明：对于同一个X，所有分支允许接续的外部边界占用完全相同。某个较小k能与后段Y组合时，同X的较大k也能与它组合，而且给出严格更大的总分。因而较小层不可能参与该最终边界类的最高分。最高层的全部并列来源系数仍累积，所以不仅最优值，最优层的C/W/M也保真。

这不是质量保守演化；它是“只问最大事件数及最优层系数”的观察投影。若要总分支数、平稳权重、较低分层或首次到达过程，不能丢弃低分层。

旧例中，前段P=1+B145，后段Q=(1+A123)(1+C456)，边界可取{1,4,5}。前段必须保留两行：X空/k=0，以及X={1,4,5}/k=1。它们的未来兼容性不同，不互相淘汰。接续后得到AC、k=2，不再被B卡住。六种事件输入顺序均实际验证。

完整终点分层为k=0,1,2的系数1,3,1；若每事件额外乘eta=2，完整预算为11，而最高层预算仅4。故本补丁不能用于把上轮选择器的分母11改成4。最优化与概率/全质量必须使用不同接口。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 4. 何时可以忘记一个发生；必要性范围
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 4. 何时可以忘记一个发生；必要性范围

已处理事件的发生域为D_done，未处理全部事件的发生域为D_future，则保留B=D_done intersect D_future。只有证明某发生不会再被任何允许的后续模块读取/占用后，才能从边界中删除；删除时按新X及相同k再次BRC重合。

所有未来因子必须已知或由接口契约保证。这里的全局编排不是给晶胞授予预知未来/即时协调能力。若真实开放系统可产生新的事件或释放旧事件，必须更新接口，不能沿用这份删除许可。

在允许任意“一个指定边界发生b加两个全新私有发生”的测试事件的语言中，不同X必可区分：取b属于X与Y的对称差，该测试事件在一个状态可添加，在另一个状态被阻断。每种X可由给各b配两个私有发生的三元装配实现。因此最坏情况下2^|B|种占用标签不能任意合并。固定稀疏事件库可能有额外等价；不宣称本X在所有语境都是唯一最小编码。

精确分数表最多(|H|+1)2^|B|个键；只问最优时最多2^|B|个键。单事件正向扫描每个键至多产生“跳过/选择”两个分支。这是代数操作数量界，不忽略大整数位数、输入保存或证据日志空间；未知大边界不保证高效。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 5. 201事件长链：从限制到构造
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 5. 201事件长链：从限制到构造

消费上轮path_library(n)：冲突图A0-B1-A1-...-Bn-An，每个事件三个发生。按链顺序处理时，已处理与未来只共享一个发生，故最大活动边界为1。

n=100时有201个事件、403个发生；全部兼容装配数为

1188518561323126046432205871807859915657177.

本轮没有展开这些装配。精确分层扫描与原BRC独立集计数递推相符；最优扫描始终最多两行，得到唯一最大装配101个事件、余100个未分配发生。最优不是“全部残差清零”；完整分层扫描峰值201行，另行保留全部得分分布。两个活动分组不等于整个程序只占两格空间，也不等于原生世界只有两态。

n=2,4,7还逐个前缀与原完整BRC装配对照；n=100只做上述压缩和BRC递推校验，没有声称穷举其完整分支。一般正确性来自第2至4节证明，不靠大实例数量证明。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 6. 释放语言的反例：同占用、同分数，但成员分组不同
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 6. 释放语言的反例：同占用、同分数，但成员分组不同

保持同一TEST_ONLY库：A=123、C=456、D=124、E=356、F=237，库存I={1,...,7}。比较J={A,C}与J'={D,E}。两者都使用1至6、剩7、事件数2、正系数1；对边界{1,2,3}的精确分层表相同，甚至完整已占用集合也相同。

现在明确扩展后续语言，执行同一个成员查询：“释放包含发生1的当前预留事件”，再尝试添加F。每个当前状态中的该事件唯一。

J释放A，剩C，空闲{1,2,3,7}，F可添加；
J'释放D，剩E，空闲{1,2,4,7}，F因发生3仍被占用而不可添加。

原发生与历史不删除；被阻断提案单独保留。单位分支权重是此确定性接口检查的计数权重，不是物理释放代价为零。成员查询是本轮明确声明的测试操作，不冒充原生许可；它揭示何种未来语言会使正向边界商失效。

因此“谁占用了哪个参与者/哪些参与者属于同一事件”可能比占用位更强。原生重新分配若能区分这些关系，必须保留它们或等价可恢复状态；只知道总残差、当前占用，甚至占用加事件数，都不够。并未在此证明任何特定全状态元组普适充分。

entries.title: 当前成员分组的残差补丁：可释放接口、最小性与平均关联反例
entries.summary_zh: 可释放接口保留σ_B(J)=(非空事件迹P_B,不可见事件数κ_B)，对声明reserve/release和占用/总数观察充分且在纯状态信息划分意义最小。部分分组数递推给b≤6的1,2,5,15,51,192,789。平均两两关联不能替代联合分组分布：偶/奇三模块族有相同低阶资料但重组成功率1/4与0。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 1. 消费前沿，不再重复原反例
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 1. 消费前沿，不再重复原反例

前轮已证明正向边界占用与事件数分层可组合，但成员敏感释放会使该商失效。本轮补齐这一缺口：固定操作边界内，当前成员分组可以替代形成历史；对混合分支，平均两两关联又不足以替代联合分组分布。

这是有限、一次性发生预留模型的条件定理，不是原生力学。P000、六维空间、120度原生正交、既定平方和、世界观及自动任务均不改。发生数量不是空间轴数量。科学 Source 中实际读取的 U10 CHECKPOINT（blob 770dd3f4fcd5a393632ab3d6091ab660016cec73）仍声明 native_force=false、physical_clock=false，下一项是来源明确的作用/反作用接口。一次 Lift_E 有界搜索未命中不证明全项目没有模型。本轮没有取得原生释放许可或物理代价。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 2. 精确输入与允许语言
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 2. 精确输入与允许语言

固定有限发生库存 I，当前装配 J 是两两不相交的三元素子集集合。每个子集是当前已预留的一个 TEST_ONLY 事件，不是发生过的整段历史。相同支撑没有额外、被操作读取的异质来源/材料标签。

固定可访问接口 B⊆I。本定理只允许：

- reserve(D)：D 是事先许可且完全包含在 B 的三元素集合；全体空闲时加入，否则留下原状态并记录阻挡。
- release(b)：b∈B；存在包含 b 的当前事件时释放整个事件，否则保持原状态。
- 观察 B 上的占用、当前总事件数，以及命令的成功/阻挡/空操作结果。

命令权重、允许性及形式代价不得依赖被隐藏的成员身份、事件来源、内场或形成历史。命令选择可以依赖已保留状态及已观察结果。输出不包含 B 外释放成员的姓名或其副作用。不允许命令访问 B 外发生、产生未声明的新通道，或把预留释放认作真实物理闭合逆演化。

库存与输入语法持续保存作来源；一个事件释放只改变当前预留，不销毁发生、不抹掉历史记录。这里的零响应与空事件、无分支仍分别定型。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 3. 分组投影与充分性定理
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 3. 分组投影与充分性定理

定义

P_B(J)={h∩B : h∈J, h∩B非空}，kappa_B(J)=#{h∈J : h∩B为空}，
sigma_B(J)=(P_B(J),kappa_B(J))。

P 是 B 某个子集的部分分组，每组大小1至3。大小1不代表一元原子闭合，而是一个完整三元事件在操作接口上仅露出一个成员。未在任何组中的 B 元素为空闲。kappa 只保存完全不可访问事件的数量；总事件数=|P|+kappa。它不是额外空间维度。

显式更新：release(b)删除 P 中包含 b 的唯一组，kappa不变；b空闲时不变。reserve(D)在D与所有现存组不交时添加组D，kappa不变，否则保持并标阻挡。这些规则与完整 J 的更新满足

sigma_B(F_a(J)) = Fbar_a(sigma_B(J))，

且成功/阻挡标记及当前事件总数一致。证明逐类即可：事件在 B 上的所有成员恰是该非空交集；释放整事件恰好释放这整组。新事件全部在 B，故占用判断没有隐藏的外部冲突。

对任意有限命令词归纳，得到所有声明观察相同。释放后又加入、反复释放、部分命令空操作均在范围内。无需保存形成顺序，但不删除另行保留的来源证据。

BRC提升：对完整分支族，按 sigma 进行原 cwm_recoalesce；每个命令分支按原 cwm_propagate。相同 sigma 的后继 sigma、标记及权重一致，原分配律给出“先完整更新后投影”与“先投影后更新”相同。串联保持结合律，备选保持分配律。可加形式释放次数 c 的非负整数分层，串联使 c 相加，仍有同一交换图。这里 c 不是能量或物理时间。只证明任意有限词，不声称所有无限深度 CWM 总和收敛。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 4. 指定观察语言下的纯状态最小性
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 4. 指定观察语言下的纯状态最小性

不同 P 若占用集合不同，即时占用观察已区分。若占用集合相同而分组不同，存在 b,c 在一方同组、另一方不同组。执行同一 release(b)，随后观察 c 是否占用，得到不同结果。若 P 相同而 kappa 不同，总事件数即时区分。

因此任何对上述全部观察与后续命令保真的确定性纯状态压缩，都不能合并不同 sigma。这里的“最小”是信息划分意义，不是编码位数最优，也不表示每个受限事件库都实现所有分组。若观察不包含总事件数，kappa可进一步省略。

足够多的不可访问私有发生可补齐任意接口组为完整三元组；组大小 s 需3-s个私有伙伴。由此，b个可访问成员的部分分组数 a_b 满足

a_0=1，a_b=2a_(b-1)+(b-1)a_(b-2)+C(b-1,2)a_(b-3)，负下标项忽略。

取最小成员：空闲或独自露出的组给前两类；选择另一个或两个成员同组给后两项。b=0..6得到1,2,5,15,51,192,789。与单独占用的2^6=64类相比，释放语言确实需要更细的信息。六个接口成员不是六条原生轴。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 5. 可合法缩小接口，但不能无依据扩大
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 5. 可合法缩小接口，但不能无依据扩大

若以后只访问 C⊆B，把每个旧组S替换成非空的S∩C；完全消失的旧组各给 kappa 加1。该规则满足 restrict_(B→C)(sigma_B(J))=sigma_C(J)。随后只能使用新接口许可的命令。

反例：B={1}，J={123}、J'={145}具有相同sigma。若擅自允许 reserve(267)，在J中因2已占用而阻挡，在J'中可添加。程序对此越界调用直接拒绝，而不是编造被隐藏成员。未知的未来接口变化需从保全的源状态恢复或重新取证；本商不赋予系统预知未来的能力。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 6. 更强的残差见证：全部占用及平均两两关联相同，重组响应不同
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 6. 更强的残差见证：全部占用及平均两两关联相同，重组响应不同

三个互不相交的六发生模块 g=0,1,2。模块 g 的标号整体加6g。每个模块有两种完整装配：

bit0: {123,456}；bit1: {124,356}。

使用同一 TEST_ONLY 事件库，构造两种显式准备的正权输入族，各四个分支，各权重1/4：

E: 000,011,101,110；O: 001,010,100,111。

每个分支都占用全部18个发生、恰好6个事件。每个单模块的完整分组分布相同；任意两个模块的联合分组分布也相同。因此全部成员对的平均同组关系相同。不把这两个不同的联合输入称为相同完整微观态，也不宣称无选择的物理制备。

依次 release(1)、release(7)、release(13)，再尝试 reserve({3,9,15})。模块bit0使其第三成员变空闲，bit1则仍占用。最后的新三元事件仅在000分支可添加，所以

P_E(成功)=1/4，P_O(成功)=0。

每个释放真实删除一个当前预留事件；三个释放后各分支都还剩3个事件。阻挡提案保留，成功与阻挡质量之和为1。差别不是总占用、总事件数、单模块状态分布或两模块相关造成的，而是这三个模块的联合关联未被均值表达。

任意仅用上述相同粗资料给出一个共同成功概率预测v，必有max(|v-1/4|,|v|)≥1/8。此为明确测试观察下的信息损失下界，不是物理可测下界或原生能量。

纯状态中的完整两两同组关系能恢复分组（连同占用），但其跨分支平均不能恢复联合分布。这是区分“关系矩阵”与“平均关系矩阵”的准确位置。本轮并未证明所有混合输入的完整sigma分布是唯一最小概率编码；只证明它充分，并以反例否定指定的较弱摘要。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 8. 经典先例、来源与下一步
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 8. 经典先例、来源与下一步

强可聚合/行为等价提供了“同一压缩类必须具有一致后继”的经典背景。Jacobi/Goernerup，arXiv:0710.1986v2，官方题录与摘要已核对；不宣称已读全文，本轮没有执行其特征向量算法。奇偶分支结构是经典两两独立不推出共同独立的形式；本轮增量是当前成员释放接口的精确定型、纯状态最小性、合法缩接口及实际三元重组观察。

专业查询3125/batch798b7a85-07df-41f8-8304-92f66918e9d9，原request摘要ca16f012a13497d6f1add9816ae43fb6eb1fd40594c4fafdce5642e5cf020ad0已匹配；外层及子项COMPLETED，实返1条题录摘要，上游总量未知。没有把摘要当全文或独立证明。

下一原生门禁已收窄为可检查条件：实际释放许可、输出/反作用、分支权重/代价能否全部由当前接口分组决定？若同sigma的真实事件在任一项不同，就必须补充对应的来源/内场等状态，不能使用本商。先冻结一个来源明确的原生事件及其后继，再核对这张对应图；本轮没有用自选测试规则填补该物理欠项。

entries.summary_zh: 按固定顺序释放B并记录各步完整占用/总数，可用≤|B|次释放单射重建初始σ_B；允许完整记录时操作TV距离恰等于接口联合W分布TV。n模块偶/奇族所有<n阶联合相同而完整探测区分。局部归一核不改远端边缘；条件筛选与真实跨模块干预不同，后者例给1/4或0。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 1. 从哪一处继续
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 1. 从哪一处继续

继承 20261008_residual_membership_7c2e8a 的 sigma_B=(P_B,kappa_B) 及原 reserve/release 规则，旧纯状态充分性/最小性和旧 main 不重做。本轮补三项：完整未来响应记录是否能识别混合态；任意固定阶局部联合统计是否足够；同一局部动作到底改变了远端状态，还是只改变条件推断。

研究对象依旧是已声明的 TEST_ONLY 发生预留模型。编号是发生标识，不是六条空间轴。读取当前原生定义 definitions/P000_DISCRETE_DIRECTION_TRIADIC_BALANCE_20260905.md，blob f95fd7a935ce16c875ac2756b299dfe2b7d9c8e5，其稳定元数=3不自动提供本例的释放/重组/材料位移律。本轮未新增原生作用律，不改P000、平方和、世界观或自动任务。

原函数 check_membership.py 的 blob 为 be1b60446e31c2c8489d1ce0db16cc1e952d11c8，13417字节，SHA256 0436b8c0d283333d3dc3adfc44ca57af77c3c06867cd0471ae8c121d81e81adc；本轮上传包中原字节与持久化检查点核对一致。只调用原 partial_catalog/realize/full_step/gadget/active_monomial 等接口，不重跑旧套件。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 2. 明确观察范围：完整响应记录，不只是最终快照
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 2. 明确观察范围：完整响应记录，不只是最终快照

固定有限库存 I 与接口 B。当前J为互不重叠的完整三元素事件集，sigma_B(J)=(P_B,kappa_B)。观察 O(J)=(U(J)交B, |J|)；原操作 release(b), b属于B，删除包含b的当前事件。原 reserve(D) 只对许可且完全在B内的三元素集合执行；失败保持状态并保留提案。所有原定权重/许可不读取隐藏伙伴、来源、历史或内部场。

本轮观察明确允许记录一个有限实验中各次 O 的联合记录。这与只询问每次观察的单独边缘分布、或只保存最后一次快照不同。实验会改变当前预留；不宣称非破坏性物理测量。隐藏伙伴身份及既往形成历史仍不在观察范围。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 3. 固定释放脚本重建初态接口
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 3. 固定释放脚本重建初态接口

列出B的一个固定顺序 b1,...,bb，记录初始O0；依次执行 release(bi)，每次记录Oi。记整段记录T(q)，q=sigma_B(J)。

定理A：T为q上的单射，最多b条释放命令；不需要依赖分支来选命令，也不需要查询事件名称或隐藏伙伴。

证明：若释放成功，前后占用之差 Ui-1\Ui，恰是被释放事件与B的非空交集。若b_i已经空闲，则差为空。所有初始可见组在其最早出现成员处恰被释放一次，收集全部非空差即可恢复P_B。最后所有B成员都空闲，剩余总事件数恰是kappa_B。因此解码函数D满足D(T(q))=q。完整J一般不能恢复，隐藏伙伴与不可见分组仍按原定范围省略。

这不要求演化可逆。末状态可以相同而实验记录不同：信息可由系统转入记录；删除记录后并无恢复承诺。本定理不要求将过去记录永久塞入后续状态，只要求预测当前初态可产生的允许未来记录时不能丢掉相关区别。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 4. 混合态充分性的进一步必要性与可控近似
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 4. 混合态充分性的进一步必要性与可控近似

令 mu(q) 为接口状态上的有限正CWM分支族。沿固定脚本各步系数为CWM_ONE，因此T只是对q重新标记，三项C/W/M逐项保留。对任意混合族均有 D_*(T_*mu)=mu；所以能够预测所有允许完整记录的编码，必须能区分不同的接口联合系数族。这是信息意义，不要求显式列出每个状态，也不禁止以奇偶约束、生成程序或因子结构压缩表示。

概率结论只使用规范化非负W投影，不把C或M当概率。定义 TV(mu,nu)=1/2 sum_q |mu(q)-nu(q)|。一般合法随机实验是从q到记录的同一个行和为1的核K。三角不等式与 sum_t K(q,t)=1 给 TV(mu K,nu K)<=TV(mu,nu)。固定释放记录T为单射，故 TV(T_*mu,T_*nu)=TV(mu,nu)。于是以所有这类有限实验记录事件定义的操作距离，恰等于初始接口联合W分布的TV距离。

若粗摘要把mu、nu混同为相同输入，共同预测的记录分布v必有 max(TV(T_*mu,v),TV(T_*nu,v)) >= TV(mu,nu)/2。特别地，TV=1的两个联合输入，在这种完整实验语言下共有预测最坏误差至少1/2。原四命令单成功位的1/8界依然正确；本轮使用更强的观察，不能说是同一实验自动提高了界。

反向应用：若一个近似联合分布在初始TV内误差epsilon，则其任意同规则有限记录预测误差至多epsilon。此无放大界要求两边使用同一个确切随机核；不包含动力学模型误差、未建模反馈、后选择归一化误差或CWM非W观察。全部有符号差只是两个正输出之间的比较，不引入负质量分支。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 5. 任意固定阶局部摘要都可能漏掉联合残差
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 5. 任意固定阶局部摘要都可能漏掉联合残差

沿用六发生模块：type0={123,456}，type1={124,356}，第g模块整体加6g。对n个模块，分别准备所有偶/奇奇偶性的n比特配置，每条权重2^{-(n-1)}。每条分支均占用6n发生、含2n事件。

定理B：两个族的任意少于n个模块的完整联合分组分布相同。

证明：固定k<n个比特及其值，剩余n-k个比特中，每一给定总奇偶性都有2^{n-k-1}种补全，乘以单分支权重得2^{-k}。因此不只均值与两两关系，全部k阶模块联合资料都相同。CWM细项也相同：补全数、单分支权重均一样。

但逐模块执行 release(6g+1)，观察成员6g+3是否仍占用，就能读出该模块的type比特：type0释放第三成员，type1保留它。记录n个响应并取奇偶，两个族产生奇偶0的概率分别为1和0。这里的奇偶是对观察记录的分类，不是新原子闭合、隐含力学门或空间传导。

在进一步受限的“每步只探测一个模块并记录其响应位”的语言内，任何少于n个不同模块的探测，包括适应性选择下一模块，仍不能区分两族：每个完整记录叶只依赖它已读取的那组少于n个比特，叶概率相同。此处下界不限制一般跨模块重组或可同时读取多模块的观察。n=6仅是36发生的测试，不是六轴定理。

因此，原子事件只有三个参与者，不推出长期/多模块联合信息最多三阶。这个结论没有将三元稳定元数改大，也不要求保存全部历史。此特定奇偶族可由共同均匀准备规则加一个奇偶标签紧凑描述；信息必要性不是指数空间下界。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 6. 有关联不等于有远端变化
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 6. 有关联不等于有远端变化

定理C：若初始完整联合W分布为mu(u,v)，一次操作保留v不变且其局部输出核满足 sum_(u',o) K(u',o|u)=1，那么不选择输出子集时：

mu'_V(v)=sum_(u,u',o) mu(u,v) K(u',o|u)=sum_u mu(u,v)=mu_V(v)。

无需u、v独立。原模型中，这适用于事件全部位于各自模块、且只在一个模块执行释放/模块内部重组的情形。若某事件已经跨越模块，release的真实支撑是整个事件而非命令中写出的单个成员，此时不能使用该局部性前提。

该不变性限于规范化W边缘。apply/skip的支路细分可增加C、改变M；本轮没有把全CWM误报为逐项不变。

条件筛选是不同的运算。在三模块偶/奇族中先局部释放1、7，再仅查看响应均为type0的分支，原始保留W=1/4、其余W=3/4。未经筛选的第三模块type0占比仍均为1/2；条件筛选后则为1/0。每条第三模块状态并未被上述局部操作改变；改变的是观察者所选总体与推断。此处必须同时保留未选中的3/4，而不能把条件变化命名为瞬时传导。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 7. 不新增规则，给出真正的处理/对照差异
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 7. 不新增规则，给出真正的处理/对照差异

沿用同一三模块族与原有reserve命令。对照组执行release(7)、release(13)；处理组额外执行release(1)。随后两组都执行同一个跨模块事件 reserve({3,9,15})。观察远端成员15是否占用。开始对照和处理均来自相同的完整输入族，没有依据后续结果挑选初态。

跨模块事件执行前，两组远端占用率均为1/2，故仅release(1)没有传导。

执行跨模块事件后：

- 偶族E：对照1/2，处理3/4，干预差1/4；
- 奇族O：对照1/2，处理1/2，干预差0。

证明：对照中成员3一直占用，新事件始终阻挡。处理中，三成员全空闲当且仅当初态000；偶族给它1/4，奇族不给它质量。原来15占用的1/2分支与000互斥，故增量如上。全部失败/阻挡分支保留，总W始终1。

这既是原规则下的干预响应，也表明相同低阶关系摘要不能决定干预系数。形式上，定义 Delta_(i->j)(mu)=E_mu[o_j(G A_i)]-E_mu[o_j(G)]，本例A_i为局部释放，G为其余释放与共同跨模块reserve上下文。两个低阶摘要相同的mu给Delta=1/4或0。响应读取了当前联合关系与真实操作通道，而不是从关联自动推出。

这不是原生六轴位移、能量、瞬传或最小扰动证明。当前数据并未提供真实晶胞对应的A_i/G/六轴读出，不能将三个模块改名成六条轴完成证明。要验证“一轴影响其余五轴”，须在同一合法原生初态与同一操作分支中给出五项后继对照，不能用不同制备或五个独立条件筛选拼起来。

entries.title: 残差选择器：过早最优化不可组合；可回退闭合的精确代价
entries.summary_zh: 中途Opt不是安全商：Opt(PQ)=AC而Opt(Opt(P)Q)=B。显式可回退选择器有π_η(J)=η^|J|/Z；三事件卡点的首次到达均值随η最终增长，长期最优占比趋1不等于快速首次解困。路径冲突族证明任意固定撤回规模的严格改进可不足，中性交换则能通达。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 1. 母问题、继承与本轮真正新增
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 1. 母问题、继承与本轮真正新增

用户继续“代数是否需要残差补丁”。继承上轮一次性三元装配，不重跑三轴路径、顺序统计或旧全套。旧接口说明局部极大装配未必使剩余最少，本轮继续三个明确问题：中间最优化能否与接续组合相容；允许解配后能否离开该卡点；增大闭合偏好是否加速到达整体最优。

当前读取的U7检查点 research_notes/chatgpt_direct/20261007_cell_u7_uniform_spread_a6c9d2/CHECKPOINT.json，blob24eefaff533d3ec1a678ffae464d0b5725ebee09，仍是CONDITIONAL_UNREVIEWED_NOT_NATIVE_FORCE，native_force=false。它没有给本轮提供获证的原生Lift_E；此陈述只限实际读取范围，不证明全项目不存在其他候选。本轮不继续尝试用位移零和充当三元作用证书，不改P000、原生正交、平方和或世界观。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 2. 固定三元装配与过早最优化的不相容
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 2. 固定三元装配与过早最优化的不相容

完整库存I={1,2,3,4,5,6}是六次发生标识，不是六条空间轴。沿用A=123、B=145、C=456三个TEST_ONLY事件；同一次装配不重复分配发生。兼容装配为0、A、B、C、AC；这里0仅在状态表中简写空选择，代数空选择是乘法单位1，不是无分支的系数零。

令P=1+B，Q=(1+A)(1+C)，乘法为上轮原BRC兼容装配，Opt保留事件数量最大的项。于是

Opt(PQ)=AC，而 Opt(Opt(P)Q)=B。

理由：在P内B比空选择好；但B与A、C都冲突，而空选择可以接上AC。计算实际调用旧factor/times/assemble与正CWM。原始装配仍然结合；失败的是中间Opt压缩的上下文保真，不是证明结合律失效。最优性不是可以无条件先做的代数商。上下文范围不明时不能仅保留当前最小残差分支。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 3. 新声明的可回退选择器，不是原生动力学
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 3. 新声明的可回退选择器，不是原生动力学

现在明确扩展操作语言：释放已选事件对发生的占用，或重新预留一个兼容事件。释放不毁灭输入发生；I始终不变，已发生的操作日志也不被改写。该可撤回预留语义是本轮新测试规则，不是推导出物理闭合可逆、倒转时间或无代价拆键。

一般有限事件库H，m=|H|>0，参数eta为正有理数。每个算法尝试均匀选择一个事件h；以eta/(1+eta)提议将它设为已选，以1/(1+eta)提议设为未选。已选提议仅在与其他已选事件无冲突时实现，否则保留原状态；未选提议释放h或保持其缺席。全部2m个提案及其不动/被阻断结果保留，不后选择归一化。eta只是选择器偏好，不是温度、能量或力。一次尝试不是物理时间或一次心跳。

状态J为当前兼容事件集合，U为已占用发生，R=I\U。程序逐项保留选择事件、提议位、实现效果及后继。完整尝试词由此语法保持；只有对于本冻结规则和当前J/首次到达/长期占比观察，才用有限J状态合并历史。来源敏感、解配副作用、事件时序或原生内态一旦参与未来，须重新扩展。

每个提案权重由cwm_edge及cwm_propagate形成；同一后继的替代提案用cwm_recoalesce。明确允许的total投影产生非负有理转移核。反复尝试的计数C通常增长，不声称存在有限的全深度CWM；只对W进行下述平稳分布/首次到达求和，全部有限提案仍有来源语法。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 4. 平稳分布与有限参数的边界
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 4. 平稳分布与有限参数的边界

该有限链的平稳total分布为

pi_eta(J)=eta^|J| / Z，Z=sum_(K compatible) eta^|K|。

证明：J与J+h之间，添加概率a=eta/[m(1+eta)]、删除概率d=1/[m(1+eta)]，满足eta^|J| a=eta^(|J|+1) d。每对邻接流量相同，所以piP=pi。任何J可先逐项释放至空，再逐项添加目标K；正有理eta确保每步有正概率，所以有限链不可约。每个状态有不动概率，因此非周期，分布趋于唯一pi。

三事件例Z=1+3eta+eta^2，pi(AC)=eta^2/Z，平稳平均未分配数为(6+9eta)/Z。有限eta下所有兼容状态都有正权；AC不是吸收态，下一尝试离开它的概率2/[3(1+eta)]>0。首次到达最优、长期多数时间处于最优、到达后永久停留是三个不同命题。停止在第一次最优需要额外的算法停止条件，不能把它默认为原生稳定。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 5. 精确首次到达：更强闭合偏好可更慢解困
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 5. 精确首次到达：更强闭合偏好可更慢解困

按0,A,B,C,AC排序。a=eta/[3(1+eta)]，d=1/[3(1+eta)]。转移行分别为

0: (1-3a,a,a,a,0)
A: (d,1-d-a,0,0,a)
B: (d,0,1-d,0,0)
C: (d,0,0,1-d-a,a)
AC:(0,d,0,d,1-2d)。

这些行由完整提案生成，而不是直接填矩阵。三步指定分支B -> 0 -> A -> AC的权重为d*a^2=eta^2/[27(1+eta)^3]，未分配数沿途3 -> 6 -> 3 -> 0。若只准单事件增删且每步禁止剩余增加，B没有离开路径。允许直接多事件交换会改变此边界，不能据此声称所有更新规则都需要先增加剩余。

令T_J为首次到达AC所需尝试数期望，T_AC=0。由第一步分解：

T_B=1/d+T_0；T_A=T_C=(1+dT_0)/(a+d)；
3aT_0=1+a(2T_A+T_B)。

代入a+d=1/3得

T_0=3(1+eta)(eta^2+4eta+1)/(2eta^2)，
T_B=3(eta+1)^2(3eta+1)/(2eta^2)。

这也是正BRC首次到达存活质量之和：移去目标行列后的Q满足T=(I-Q)^(-1)1。实际调用未改动的finite_recurrent_mass_analysis(Q)，取得正有理canonical_potential及整数证书Qh<h；没有另外写普通矩阵求逆作为科学后门。完整P的全深度质量不收敛，程序另行检查它不会被误标为稳定星。

有限eta下，从任何状态用至多三次指定未选提案清空，再两次指定已选提案形成AC，五步成功概率至少d^3*a^2>0。因此首次到达尾部有几何上界，期望有限。这是算法尝试上的证明，不是物理时间律。

实际样本（全部精确有理）：

eta | pi(AC) | T_B
1/10 | 1/131 | 4719/20
1/2 | 1/11 | 135/4
1 | 1/5 | 24
3/2 | 9/31 | 275/12
2 | 4/11 | 189/8
3 | 9/19 | 80/3
10 | 100/131 | 11253/200
100 | 10000/10301 | 9211503/20000

pi(AC)随eta增大趋于1，T_B却满足T_B/eta趋于9/2。因而提高长期最优占比不保证更快首次解困。eta无穷的逐步极限使删除概率为0，B变成吸收卡点。于是从B出发，先取长尝试极限再令eta增大，AC占比趋于1；反过来先冻结为绝不释放再无限尝试，AC占比始终0。两种极限不可互换。有限eta的随机重排不是处处单调最小残差过程，更不是天然的永久最优选择器。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 6. 任意固定规模的严格改进交换都可能不足
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 6. 任意固定规模的严格改进交换都可能不足

构造2n+1个三元事件，冲突图为路径A0-B1-A1-...-Bn-An。相邻事件共用一个发生，其他发生皆私有；用私有发生补足每个事件3项。共4n+3个发生。这是发生冲突结构，不是原生空间连线、力传播距离或新轴定义。

选择全部B有n个事件。路径上最多可选n+1项，而且唯一达到者为全部A：若选了n+1个互不相邻位置，它们在长度2n+1的序列中必须恰好占所有偶数位。因此任何严格增加事件数的单次交换都必须撤回全部n个B。对任意固定k，取n>k就得到无法用至多k次旧事件撤回作严格改进的卡点。

但允许中性交换时存在明确路线：依次把B_(i+1)换成A_i，i=0,...,n-1；每次事件数仍为n且无冲突，最后加A_n得到n+1。故这里需要的是跨步保持关系并移动未配对状态，而不是每一步都立即变好。这不排除其他允许操作、并行交换或有预见的规则。

程序完整枚举n=1..6库的5,13,34,89,233,610个兼容装配，检查唯一最优、全部严格改进所需撤回数以及上述全部中性路线。一般n的结论由前段组合证明给出，不由有限枚举外推。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 8. 经典先例、意义与下一步
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 8. 经典先例、意义与下一步

此选择器是冲突图独立集上的单点heat-bath/Glauber更新的具体实例，不是新发明通用采样法。Galvin/Tetali，arXiv:1206.3165v1，官方题录摘要与专用返回已取得：大偏好参数可导致某些图族混合缓慢。本文首次到达的五状态精确公式是此固定接口的自足计算，混合时间与首次到达时间不混同。Cygan，arXiv:1304.1424，官方摘要给出集合打包和有界交换局部搜索的先例；不声称读完全篇或获得文献范围新最优界。

专用检索Issue3009，batch cf68c608-acd0-4080-ac56-b2b85150cb8d，原请求摘要5eda2f5a6c262e52d0b8bc0a8c6434ffb7d75404e871480ca5a10a450a20ce9b匹配。外层与子项均COMPLETED，返回1条题录/摘要，上游总量未知；不是全文或系统综述。原回传保留于原Issue。

本轮结论：残差补丁包括操作相关信息、兼容性和选择规则，尤其不能在接续前过早最优化。加入明确可回退规则后可以精确解困，但更偏向当前闭合不必更快达到整体最优，且有限参数不会永久停在最优。原生Lift_E、解配许可及代价、事件副作用和材料更新仍未获证；不能把算法回退变成真实可逆力学。

下一最小原生接口问题应更具体：一个已经形成的原生三元事件，在何种背景下允许重新分配参与者，释放到哪些带来源的状态，代价是什么？冻结一个这样的实例，再消费本轮选择器/交换证书；不要继续重做零和障碍、旧顺序阶数或把TEST_ONLY事件名称提升为原生证书。
