entries.title: Euler contact-interleaved holonomy: zero winding is not zero action
entries.summary_zh: 允许接触穿插后零signed winding不等于零作用。单triangle控制态(j,r)有36元素标准形A_(k,u,v)，12状态是相对声明未来/通道观察的最小划分；四个未归一化条件相位矩精确闭合。误差对全部允许词界为2Σ_r||δv_r||∞，并非物理稳定界。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 1. Exact scope and executed reuse
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 1. Exact scope and executed reuse

The prior signed-winding theorem concerns PURE transport with no intermediate contacts. This unit keeps its reciprocal edge law unchanged and inserts the already existing three-channel contact at the same comparison base. It classifies the resulting controlled actions and proves an exact phase observer. No new local force, routing probability or contact-selection mechanism is proposed.

Fix the named comparison triangle gamma=(0,1,2,0), with explicit arrows 0->1,1->2,2->0; other edge records remain present and unchanged by these commands. The base frame/reference is fixed. Prescribed paths and their genuine inverses are allowed controls, including an immediate reversal at command boundaries. This is NOT a modification of the previous autonomous nonbacktracking policy. Control words specify where to insert collisions; they are not derived physical schedules. Comparison vertices, channel labels, control count and relative sheet bits are not native X6 coordinates, extra spatial axes, calibrated heartbeat time or energy. P000 and residual fidelity remain unchanged.

U is one forward triangle transport; U^-1 is its reciprocal reversed path. C is the unchanged contact P^chi with persistence 1 (retaining the carried sign). C^-1 is implemented by TWO actual C calls, because P^3=I; no new inverse collision implementation is assumed. Explicit paths retain fields, true previous/current vertices, positive weights, roots, choices and chronological history. The observer/action quotients below exclude the true incoming port, spectator field labels and history. Those exclusions are justified only because the declared future controls never query them.

Prior archive euler_reciprocal_transport_evidence.zip has SHA256 82d6df81c537c4c9f2085d226393da2be1777d6da2532b20a5f96dadc3416fef; all 44 manifest entries were verified during this build. Fifteen required Python modules were copied byte-for-byte, without old scientific checkers. The old brc_reciprocal_transport.py SHA256 is 2ae3f3034364a96658666fc93850fab7adb6e1fef3850a414c92d5f731ea38ce. Its follow/prescribed functions execute the original sourced comparison reads and positive CWM updates. Contacts execute brc_route_memory.contact unchanged. Full brc_weighted.py still matches current source Git blob 3f205696709e847909958a153f8fe10d3f6b70f0. The existing inspected chirality excerpt is still tied to full source blob 6f8b147c094720c2749f620a40394c4d7b67a386, not misrepresented as the whole module.

REUSE_EXECUTED / COMPOSE_APPLIED / EXTEND_EXISTING_TOOL. The extension adds control composition and proved observers, not an accepted new BRC family. No numerical pi, trigonometry, roots, matrix exponential or alternative numerical world propagator is used. Finite group and coefficient computations certify actual BRC rows, not positive populations.

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 2. A closed contact word can retain a channel change at zero signed winding
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 2. A closed contact word can retain a channel change at zero signed winding

Let s denote the carried bit relative to the fixed base frame, and f the current triangle parity including the declared arrow correction. Put r=2s+f modulo 4 and sigma(r)=+1 for r=0,1, -1 for r=2,3. The prior result gives U:r->r+1, U^-1:r->r-1. On unit-count channel triples, let j=0,1,2 for A,B,field, so P increases j modulo 3. Actual controls induce

U:(j,r)->(j,r+1),
C:(j,r)->(j+sigma(r),r).

All future indices in these formulas are modular. In particular U^2 reverses the carried sheet for every f, while restoring the entire raw triangle field. Ordinary operator conjugation therefore gives U^2 C U^-2=C^-1.

Two chronological programs use the same two forward laps, two reverse laps and three primitive contacts:

A: U, U, C, U^-1, U^-1, C, C.
B: U, U, U^-1, U^-1, C, C, C.

Both have zero net signed traversal count on every edge. Both restore the complete field and sheet; they also end with the same incoming neighbour as each other. B has net identity. In A, the first contact reads the reversed sheet, and the other two read the initial sheet. Its channel exponent is -chi+2chi=chi, so its endpoint action is precisely C. Neither total winding nor total collision count modulo three captures this distinction.

For an initially field-only unit with fair signs, zeta0=omega^2, omega^2+omega+1=0. The two laboratory phase outputs are zeta_A=-zeta0/2 and zeta_B=zeta0. Total positive weight stays 1. This was checked for all 64 initial fields, all eight binary triples and both signs, not only the displayed preparation.

There is also a field-sensitive return experiment. The chronological word

W: U, C, U^-1, C^-1

has zero signed winding and preserves field/sheet. Its channel exponent is chi[(-1)^f-1], which is 0 modulo 3 for f=0 and chi for f=1. Hence W is identity on channels when f=0 and performs C when f=1. It transfers a specific comparison-field distinction into the channel without changing that field or sheet. It is NOT a nondisturbing measurement of the full state: channels, incoming port and audit history can change. The control U,U^-1,C,C,C uses the same six traversed edges and three contacts but is identity.

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 3. Complete 36-element controlled action algebra on one triangle
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 3. Complete 36-element controlled action algebra on one triangle

For u,v in Z/3 and k in Z/4 define f_(u,v)(r) by the four values (u,v,-u,-v). Every controlled word acts as

A_(k,u,v):(j,r)->(j+f_(u,v)(r),r+k).

Chronological multiplication (first g=(k,u,v), then h=(l,a,b)) is

(k,u,v) * (l,a,b) = (k+l, u+f_(a,b)(k), v+f_(a,b)(k+1)).

All modular arithmetic is explicit. The generators are U=(1,0,0) and C=(0,1,1). Closure follows because f(r+2)=-f(r) is preserved under translation and addition. Conversely C has translation vector (1,1), and executing U,C,U^-1 gives vector (1,-1). These are linearly independent over F3, so their powers generate every pair (u,v). Powers of U supply every k. Thus exactly 4*3*3=36 actions occur.

Distinct triples give distinct permutations of the 12 unit-channel/r states: k is observed in the returned r, while inputs r=0,1 distinguish u,v. The normal translation subgroup is C3 x C3; U acts on it by a fourth-order rotation of the pair. Therefore the group is (C3 x C3) semidirect C4. This is a familiar semidirect-product construction, not a new classification of abstract finite groups. It is not C12 despite the twelve atomic states. The earlier pure K4 transport group and the older fixed-field E/O group are different scopes, not contradictory counts.

The actual BRC action table of all 36 normal forms was generated. All 1296 chronological products were checked on all 12 atoms. A representative of each action requires at most six commands in {U,C}; this is the specific breadth-first representation found here, not a physical optimal-control claim.

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 4. A faithful scalar encoding exists, but a fixed scalar multiplier for every action cannot
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 4. A faithful scalar encoding exists, but a fixed scalar multiplier for every action cannot

The existing ring has alpha^4-alpha^2+1=0, omega=alpha^4 and beta=alpha^3 with beta^2=-1. For a single unit atom the scalar

xi(j,r)=omega^j beta^r=alpha^(4j+3r)

is injective on all twelve pairs. This follows from reducing equality of exponents modulo 3 and modulo 4. Thus it would be wrong to claim that a single complex/algebraic scalar can never encode the finite joint state.

Its actual updates, however, are

U: xi->beta xi,
C: xi->omega^sigma(r) xi.

The multiplier for C depends on retained state. There is no faithful fixed-multiplier description of both controls. For any homomorphism rho from the action group to nonzero complex scalars, U^2 C U^-2=C^-1 forces rho(C)=rho(C)^-1, and C^3=I forces rho(C)=1. Such a scalar action representation necessarily erases the contact. More fully the commutator subgroup is the nine-element translation subgroup: the conjugation relation puts C and its U-conjugates in the commutator subgroup, and quotienting translations leaves the abelian C4. This is a statement about representing ACTIONS by state-independent scalars, not a failure of Euler's identity or impossibility of scalar state coding.

Even injective atomic coding does not make its positive mean a complete ensemble state. Put equal weights on (j,r)=(0,0),(0,2), or instead on (0,1),(0,3). Both initial means of xi are zero, and both initial channel phases are one. After the same C, the means differ: in the alpha coefficient basis they are (-1/2,0,1,0) and (0,-1,0,1/2). Actual BRC branches give these values without signed masses.

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 5. Minimal predictive partition and exact four-block phase repair
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 5. Minimal predictive partition and exact four-block phase repair

For the declared future language generated by U,U^-1,C,C^-1 and the exact channel observation j, the twelve (j,r) states are a sufficient deterministic partition quotient. Spectator edge records and the actual incoming neighbour do not affect these prescribed controls. It is also minimal among partitions refining that observer. Different j are immediately distinguishable. With the same j, opposite sheet signs are distinguished by C. With the same j and sheet but different f, U then C distinguishes the states. All 66 pairs have a witness of at most two commands. This is not a universal state-count bound for changing triangles, field interventions or passive phase-only predictors.

For positive ensembles, define four UNNORMALIZED phase moments

v_r = sum_(paths gamma with r_gamma=r) w_gamma zeta_gamma,
zeta_gamma=a_gamma+omega b_gamma+omega^2 f_gamma.

The last f_gamma here is the field CHANNEL occupancy, not the triangle parity. The moments are algebraic readouts in Q(omega), not positive weights or extra spatial axes. The total channel phase is Z=v0+v1+v2+v3. Existing BRC operations imply exactly

U:(v0,v1,v2,v3)->(v3,v0,v1,v2),
C:(v0,v1,v2,v3)->(omega v0,omega v1,omega^2 v2,omega^2 v3).

Inverse controls use the inverse permutation/phase factors. These four moments predict the channel phase after every controlled word and after any common, history-blind normalized mixture of such words. This is an observer recurrence derived from actual typed BRC, not a replacement physical propagator.

Four Q(omega)-linear moments are also necessary for this unrestricted initial phase-moment space. The nine actions (0,u,v) give controlled readouts

Z_(u,v)=omega^u v0+omega^v v1+omega^-u v2+omega^-v v3.

Using 1+omega+omega^2=0, the character sums recover

v0=(1/9)sum_(u,v) omega^-u Z_(u,v),
v1=(1/9)sum_(u,v) omega^-v Z_(u,v),
v2=(1/9)sum_(u,v) omega^u Z_(u,v),
v3=(1/9)sum_(u,v) omega^v Z_(u,v).

The four distinct characters are independent, so no smaller linear readout can predict all these outputs for all initial signed differences of positive preparations. This is minimal LINEAR observation dimension over Q(omega), not four physical states and not a ban on nonlinear encodings. The nine formulas describe separate controls applied to copies of the same preparation, or an algebraic observability certificate; they are not nine passive observations of one unchanged physical run.

Equivalently, all future channel phases vanish iff each v_r vanishes separately. In the twelve-bin rational mass description, the corresponding kernel consists exactly of equal A/B/field masses within each fixed r (or their signed differences). Thus its rational linear dimension is four. Present cancellation Z=0 is a larger set and is not permission to erase the r-conditioned distinctions.

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 6. A uniform error certificate with declared observation scope
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 6. A uniform error certificate with declared observation scope

Suppose the four stored initial moments have coefficient errors delta v_r in the existing alpha basis, and all subsequent observer operations are exact. Any normal form only permutes the blocks and multiplies each by 1,omega or omega^2. Their coefficient matrices, generated by the existing exact phase interface, have infinity operator norm at most 2. Hence, for every allowed future word,

||delta Z||_infinity <= 2 sum_r ||delta v_r||_infinity <= 8 epsilon

when each block error is at most epsilon. Common normalized positive mixtures preserve the same bound. This controls arbitrary word length because the actual net action stays in the proven finite group; it is not a product of pessimistic one-step norms. It does not cover rounding freshly introduced at every future step, parameter changes, state-dependent control selection using omitted information, measurements of path provenance, or a different loop family.

When count, total positive mass and dominant path weight matter, use the twelve-bin CWM carrier rather than the phase moments alone. For the specific independent command mixture {U,C} with weights 1/2, explicit and twelve-bin updates agree through seven commands from every atomic input, with total CWM (2^n,1,2^-n). Fixed bin count does not imply fixed bit complexity or disappearance of histories. No performance speedup is established.

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 1. Objective and supported composition
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 1. Objective and supported composition

For every unordered comparison edge {a,b}, define M_ab: when the writer is at a it follows the old reciprocal edge a->b; at b it follows b->a; at either other node it executes a recorded unit-weight hold. Thus M_ab is its own inverse on transport core data. It does not automatically restore the previous incoming neighbour, elapsed time or history. Each command is chosen commonly for the whole preparation; its endpoint condition is evaluated on each complete world. Common positive normalized mixtures of such commands are also covered.

This is the continuation's mathematical working domain, not a permanent user restriction on other controls. Writer contacts, selectors using its omitted sheet/history, interleaved commands while a probe loop is unfinished, or different local responses can be researched with their own closure. formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 2. Exact joint observer
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 2. Exact joint observer

Let j in Z3 label the probe's unit channel, s in F2 its carried sheet relative to the base, F=(F1,F2,F3) the prior three corrected triangle bits, and w its writer's current comparison node. The atomic observer is

x=(j,s,F,w).

The six writer edge masks b_ab in face coordinates, in edge order01,02,03,12,13,23, are

b01=110, b02=101, b03=011, b12=100, b13=010, b23=001.

These are derived from which actual triangle contains the traversed edge. The induced rows are

Ui: (j,s,F,w) -> (j,s+Fi,F+111,w),
Ui^-1: (j,s,F,w) -> (j,s+Fi+1,F+111,w),
C: (j,s,F,w) -> (j+(-1)^s,s,F,w),
M_ab: if w in {a,b}, (j,s,F,w)->(j,s,F+b_ab,the other endpoint); otherwise identity.

Here bit additions are XOR and j is modulo3. These equations hold for every initial raw field: they do not infer that the three face bits reconstruct all six raw edge records. Writer sheet/channel do not enter these particular rows because the existing edge field toggle is independent of them and the controller reads only its current position.

There are192 atomic classes: 3*2*8*4. This is an exact deterministic quotient for the channel observation under the specified command language. It is minimal among partitions refining that observation. If j differs, the present observation distinguishes the pair. If j is equal but s differs, C distinguishes. If j,s agree but a face Fi differs, Ui then C distinguishes. Finally, if only writer nodes w and v differ, choose an edge {w,h} with h distinct from both w and v. M_wh acts on the first state only and changes at least one face Fi; Ui then C distinguishes them. Thus every pair is separated by at most three commands. The checker supplies all18,336 such pair witnesses from actual BRC-derived rows.

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 3. Conservation removes redundant position information when its value is known
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 3. Conservation removes redundant position information when its value is known

At probe command boundaries the previous invariant is

Q=(F2+F1,F3+F1)+q(w),
q(0)=00, q(1)=01, q(2)=10, q(3)=11.

Each command preserves Q. During a probe loop the full previous formula also includes q(probe_position); its base-boundary simplification is not applied mid-loop.

Because q is a bijection, fixing one exact Q for ALL branches gives

w=q^-1(Q+(F2+F1,F3+F1)).

Thus no independent writer-position record is needed at command boundaries once Q and the three faces are jointly known. There are48 possible (j,s,F) states in each fixed-Q class, not192. All48 can be reached by these controls: writer gates connect its four positions, probe loops can reverse the common face bit and sheet, and C cycles the probe channel. Actual row reachability gives exactly four orbits of48, corresponding to the four Q values.

This differs from the earlier closed-probe-only eta sectors. The writer can move between all four field eta values while Q stays fixed. A known fixed total Q does not mean a known fixed field eta. Knowing merely the marginal distribution of Q is also different from knowing how Q is paired with the conditional field/phase state.

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 4. Equal field, position AND conserved-label marginals do not determine the future
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 4. Equal field, position AND conserved-label marginals do not determine the future

Use four equally weighted complete worlds in each preparation, with probe j=field, s=0, F1=0; writer sheet positive and writer channel fixed. Choose raw fields by the prior representative function, so identical F values have identical raw fields in both preparations. Let eta=(F2,F3). The two pairings are

eta     writer in A     writer in B
00           0               0
01           2               3
10           3               1
11           1               2.

Each row has positive weight1/4. Both preparations have the SAME full probe-sheet/face marginal, the same raw-field marginal, the same complete writer marginal (incoming is chosen as a fixed function of w), and the same total-Q marginal (uniform on00,01,10,11). Initial probe phase is omega^2=-alpha^2 in both.

Execute M13, U2, C (code M13,U1+,C+). M13 toggles only F2 when active. In preparation A, writer at1 or3 occurs precisely when F2=1. After M13 every branch therefore has F2=0. U2 leaves probe sheet positive and C moves its field unit to A, yielding

Z_A=1.

In preparation B, after the same gate exactly half the branches have F2=0 and half have F2=1. The common loop/contact then yields A/B channels equally, hence

Z_B=(1+omega)/2=-omega^2/2=alpha^2/2.

The actual BRC execution confirms both outcomes. Every branch retains its own Q throughout, with one global world weight, not a product of two independent fields. The observer histories are different and retained.

The four-alpha-coefficient infinity distance between the two outcomes is1. Consequently any prediction based ONLY on those identical separately saved marginals has worst-case coefficient error at least1/2 on this pair. Better arithmetic precision cannot repair the omitted pairing. This is an information bound in the declared observer, not a physical measurement-error claim.

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 5. Exact conditional phase repair: 64 moments, or16 at known Q
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 5. Exact conditional phase repair: 64 moments, or16 at known Q

For positive ensembles define UNNORMALIZED moments

v_(s,F,w)=sum_(worlds in this joint mode) world_weight * probe_channel_phase.

Every value belongs to K=Q(omega), omega^2+omega+1=0. It is represented using the already used alpha basis; these phase moments are not positive masses. Their total is Z=sum v.

Loop commands and writer gates permute mode indices by section2. C multiplies s0 blocks by omega, s1 blocks by omega^2; its inverse uses inverse factors. Thus all64 moments exactly predict Z after any allowed common control word and any normalized common positive mixture. For known fixed Q only the16 modes satisfying section3 occur, with position reconstructed as needed. Their dynamics stay closed and the old external writer field is no longer an unexplained source term.

Both linear dimensions are minimal over K on the span of differences of positive preparations. One proof uses old exact face-selective contacts D_G, which apply C only when F=G and otherwise fix the probe channel, restoring all mode data. The old multicycle selector explicitly synthesizes D_G from prior loops/contacts. Add the conjugates M_ab,D_G,M_ab. These are also diagonal on the joint mode, multiplying its phase by a third root of unity.

Any two of the64 modes have different characters of the finite commuting diagonal subgroup generated by these probes. If s or F differs, a D_G distinguishes them. If only w differs, take an edge incident to one w but not the other; its nonzero face mask makes an appropriate conjugated D_G distinguish them. Distinct finite characters are linearly independent over K. Equivalently, products of the elementary coefficient projectors (I+lambda^-1 D+lambda^-2 D^2)/3 isolate each mode. Such linear combinations are readout reconstruction identities across controlled copies, not negative positive-mass preparations. The same argument applies to the16 modes in a fixed Q class.

There is a smaller practical certificate than enumerating that diagonal group. A span-closure search using ONLY actual BRC atomic action rows produced64 control words, each at most six macro commands. Their64x64 phase observation matrix has entries1,omega,omega^2. Under the exact ring homomorphism Z[omega]->F7 sending omega->2, its determinant is1. Hence its determinant in K is nonzero; this does NOT assert the exact determinant itself equals1. All4096 selected matrix entries were independently compared within this run with actual explicit BRC worlds executing the corresponding word. This is an implementation crosscheck, not independent replication.

The64 controlled outputs on identically prepared copies therefore recover all64 moments by exact linear algebra. No scheme of fewer fixed K-linear scalar probes recovers arbitrary64-dimensional initial moments. Each fixed-Q domain admits16 selected probes, in the generated lists of at most four macro commands, also with full exact rank. These are interventions on copies, not64 or16 passive samples of a single altered trajectory. Number of macro commands is not physical time or a minimum pulse-count claim.

The exact all-future zero criterion is correspondingly

Z_after_every_allowed_control=0 iff v_(s,F,w)=0 for EVERY joint mode,

or iff all16 present blocks vanish when Q is fixed. Uniform A/B/field mass within every separate mode is a nonempty positive example with all such phases zero. Current Z=0 alone is a weaker cancellation. Positive count, total and dominant weights still require the192-bin or48-bin CWM quotient rather than phase moments alone.

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 6. Uniform future error bounds and the scope of zero phase
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 6. Uniform future error bounds and the scope of zero phase

A deterministic control word permutes joint modes and multiplies their phase contribution by1,omega oromega^2. The existing alpha coefficient maps have infinity operator norm at most2. Therefore, for errors in the initially stored moments and exact subsequent updates,

sup_words ||Delta Z||_infinity <=2 sum_modes ||Delta v_mode||_infinity.

If each stored block has coefficient error <=epsilon, this yields128epsilon for64 arbitrary modes, or32epsilon for16 fixed-Q modes. Common normalized positive mixtures preserve the bound. It does not grow with command count because each NET word has this exact monomial form. Newly introduced errors at later steps, uncertainty in which Q class is occupied, or new operations require separate analysis.

The rank certificate proves invertibility of the controlled probe system, not a measured-device noise bound or an optimal condition number. The forward bounds just given concern already stored initial moments; they are not silently applied to noisy probe inversion.

For independent equal choices among U1,C,M13, explicit paths and the exact CWM quotient agree through five commands from two specified initial states. From one unit initial world their total CWM is (3^n,1,3^-n). Histories and sources remain in explicit evidence; fixed slot count does not imply fixed bit complexity or computational acceleration.

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 1. Objective, supported operations and evidence basis
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 1. Objective, supported operations and evidence basis

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 2. Shared edges create conserved relative field labels
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 2. Shared edges create conserved relative field labels

Let F_i be the XOR of current records around gamma_i, plus the XOR of its against-arrow traversals. It is exactly the existing triangle_bit readout. Let s=0 or1 encode the carried sheet relative to the fixed base reference. Write j=0,1,2 for unit occupancy in A,B,field; P increments j modulo3.

Each rooted triangle contains three edges; each pair shares exactly one edge. An actual traversal therefore toggles ALL the F_i in the selected family, while its sheet update reads its own F_i. For m=1,2,3 selected rooted triangles, the executed endpoint laws are

U_i: (j,s,F) -> (j,s+F_i,F+1),
U_i^-1: (j,s,F) -> (j,s+F_i+1,F+1),
C: (j,s,F) -> (j+(-1)^s,s,F).

Bit additions are XOR; the channel addition is modulo3. The laws follow from old edge operations before reading the result, rather than imposing a scalar phase on the state.

Consequently eta_i=F_i+F_1, i=2,...,m, are invariant under every U_i and C and their inverses. They remain invariant along every individual branch of any mixture of those commands. There are 2^(m-1) invariant sectors. The total positive mass in each sector is conserved. This does not assert that its conditional channel phase is nonzero, or that phase cancellation destroys sector mass.

Inside a sector, put r=2s+F_1 mod4 and eta_1=0. Then

U_i: r -> r+(-1)^eta_i mod4,
C: j -> j+sigma(r) mod3, sigma=(1,1,-1,-1).

Thus each sector is a copy of the old four-mode observer, but different sectors assign the SAME second/third loop to opposite increments. A known, fixed sector still needs only four phase moments. An ensemble mixing unknown sectors generally needs their joint weights and phases, not their averaged loop signs.

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 3. A witness that the old four moments are insufficient after adding a second loop
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 3. A witness that the old four moments are insufficient after adding a second loop

Use two loops, and let V be chronological U_2,U_1^-1. It changes r by 2eta_2 while preserving eta_2. Its pure raw field action is nontrivial in general, but V^-1 is a real inverse path command. Define the chronological word

W = V, C, V^-1, C^-1.

The field and sheet are restored. Its channel exponent is [(-1)^eta_2-1](-1)^s modulo3. Hence

eta_2=0: W acts as identity;
eta_2=1: W acts exactly as C.

Prepare a field-channel unit with F_1=0 and fair carried signs. Compare eta_2=0 versus eta_2=1. Both have identical OLD four moments (0,0,-1/2,0) in modes r0 and r2, and zero in the other modes, in the alpha coefficient basis. Their outputs after W are respectively

Z_0=zeta_initial=-alpha^2,
Z_1=-zeta_initial/2=alpha^2/2.

Their coefficient separation is3/2. Any predictor receiving only the old common four-moment record has worst error at least3/4 on this pair. This is information loss, not roundoff. All final field and sheet records are restored separately within each preparation; the two preparations did not have identical full initial fields. Actual path histories and positive weights are retained.

There is a stronger joint-relation witness. Fix j=field,s=0. Preparation A assigns weights1/2 to face pairs (0,0),(1,1); preparation B assigns weights1/2 to (0,1),(1,0). Both have identical marginals (j,s,F_1) and (j,s,F_2), hence identical separately saved single-loop observations, current channel phases, and total weight. A is entirely in eta0 and B entirely in eta1. Under W, A gives omega^2 while B gives1. Saving each loop separately does not preserve how their fields are paired.

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 4. Constructive controlled access to every field tuple
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 4. Constructive controlled access to every field tuple

For p in F2^m, let T_p execute each U_i with p_i=1 once, in increasing i. Because every previous selected loop toggles the next F_i, its sheet increment is

p.F + q_p,   q_p=binom(|p|,2) mod2.

The conjugate word D_p = T_p, C, T_p^-1 restores field and sheet and changes the channel by

(-1)^s (-1)^(p.F+q_p) modulo3.

All phase functions (-1)^(p.F) form the Walsh sign table. Over F3 its orthogonality reads H H^T=2^m I; 2^m is invertible. Therefore conjugate contacts generate every field-conditioned translation

N_a: (j,s,F) -> (j+(-1)^s a(F),s,F),

where a:F2^m->F3 is arbitrary. This construction uses integer numbers of existing C/C^-1 calls. It does not use negative positive-mass weights.

Explicitly, to obtain a(F)=1 for F=F* and0 elsewhere, combine D_p with contact exponent

c_p = (2^m)^-1 (-1)^(p.F*+q_p) in F3.

Each exponent is1 or2; exponent2 is executed by the existing inverse-contact command, itself two positive unit-weight contact calls. The word obtained restores the raw field/sheet and applies C exactly when the face tuple is F*. The supplied selector function constructs and executes these words. Their maximal lengths are4,12,32 macro commands for m1,2,3; command lengths are not physical optimal-control costs.

The sign-table identity is standard finite character/Hadamard algebra. The model-specific result is that its rows arise from actual reciprocal-loop conjugates and thereby synthesize the required conditional contacts.

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 5. Complete action group and conserved-sector structure
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 5. Complete action group and conserved-sector structure

The translation subgroup just constructed is N=(C3)^(2^m). Its functions have distinct actions on inputs with s0 and each F. The pure loop subgroup H is C4 x (C2)^(m-1), of order2^(m+1), inherited from the actual reciprocal cycle actions. In the sector description it consists exactly of

eta unchanged,   r -> r+k+2(ell.eta) mod4,

where k in Z4 and ell in F2^(m-1). Thus the pure subgroup is faithful over the full set of sectors.

Conjugation by any pure loop sends (-1)^s a(F) to another function of the same form, because it translates F and adds a known F-dependent bit to s. Hence H normalizes N. Their intersection is identity: N fixes every field/sheet mode, whereas a nonidentity H changes at least one. Every control word can therefore be collected uniquely into a translation followed by pure transport. The group is

G_m = (C3)^(2^m) semidirect [C4 x (C2)^(m-1)].

It has order 3^(2^m) * 2^(m+1):

m=1: 36 actions,12 atomic predictive states,4 phase moments,1 sector;
m=2: 648 actions,24 atomic predictive states,8 phase moments,2 sectors;
m=3: 104976 actions,48 atomic predictive states,16 phase moments,4 sectors.

The m1 line is consumed prior work, not a new discovery. For m2 the entire generated permutation group was enumerated from BRC-generated rows and matched with its normal forms. For m3 all16 pure tables, all8 elementary selectors, all6561 translation tables and their normalization relations were certified; the product theorem gives104976 without executing104976 separate long physical commands. These are familiar group constructions with new model-specific correspondence, not a novel abstract classification or a spatial dimension count.

The sectors themselves do not merge under the stated controls, even though contacts inside each sector are controllable. A single late channel average cannot determine how much weight was originally in each sector. Sector conservation persists for state-dependent choices among these same controls, while the smaller linear observer update may need additional state if that choice queries omitted data.

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 6. Exact phase repair, minimality and finite controlled diagnosis
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 6. Exact phase repair, minimality and finite controlled diagnosis

For a positive path population define unnormalized moments

v_(s,F) = sum_(paths with this sheet/face tuple) weight * channel_phase(path).

Each value lies in Q(omega); it is not positive mass. The total channel phase is Z=sum v_(s,F). There are2^(m+1) such moments. U_i simply permutes their indices by (s,F)->(s+F_i,F+1), and C multiplies the s0 moments by omega, the s1 moments by omega^2. The inverse rules use the inverse permutation or phase. These relations factor every exact BRC row and therefore every common history-blind controlled word or normalized positive mixture of words.

The atomic partition (j,s,F) is minimal for exact channel observation under the same future controls. Different j are immediately distinguishable; different s with equal j are distinguished by C; equal j,s but different F_i are distinguished by U_i then C. There are 3*2^(m+1) classes. The checker supplies witnesses for all1470 pairs across m1,m2,m3, including1128 pairs of the48-state model.

The linear phase dimension is also minimal over Q(omega), on the span of differences of positive preparations. There is a short constructive recovery. Let Z be the initial total phase. For each F, apply its selective contact to a separate copy of the same preparation, obtaining Z_F^(1), and apply it twice to another copy, obtaining Z_F^(2). Put D1=Z_F^(1)-Z, D2=Z_F^(2)-Z. Then

D1=(omega-1)v_(0,F)+(omega^2-1)v_(1,F),
D2=(omega^2-1)v_(0,F)+(omega-1)v_(1,F).

The determinant is -3(omega-omega^2), which is nonzero. Using (omega-omega^2)^2=-3 gives

v_(0,F) = -[D1+D2+(omega-omega^2)(D1-D2)]/6,
v_(1,F) = -[D1+D2-(omega-omega^2)(D1-D2)]/6.

The initial total Z does NOT need a separate probe. Summing the two outputs over the M=2^m possible F gives

sum_F [Z_F^(1)+Z_F^(2)] = (2M-3)Z.

The integer2M-3 is1,5,13 for m1,2,3, so Z is recovered exactly from the2M controlled outputs. These2M=2^(m+1) phase probes are sufficient AND minimal among fixed linear phase-probe schemes over Q(omega) on arbitrary initial moment vectors: each probe is one linear scalar functional and all2M independent moments have just been recovered. This improves the prior nine-probe single-loop certificate to a minimal four-probe certificate in its stated linear class. It makes no minimum claim for arbitrary nonlinear encodings, state-dependent physical sensors, or different priors. The probes are different controls on identically prepared copies, not passive sequential samples of one unchanged run. Every selector and the complete baseline-free reconstruction were checked against actual BRC outputs.

Thus every possible future channel phase vanishes iff EACH conditional moment is zero. Current Z=0 is only one coarser cancellation. In the unit-count rational-bin model this means equal A,B,field mass in each separate (s,F) bin, not absence of positive mass. A sum of separately saved per-loop moments is insufficient, as section3 shows.

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 7. All-word initial-error bound and positive-weight accounting
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 7. All-word initial-error bound and positive-weight accounting

Every net control permutes modes and multiplies their phase contributions by1,omega oromega^2. In the prior four-coefficient alpha representation, the infinity norms of these three coefficient maps are1,2,2. Therefore initial moment errors satisfy

sup_allowed_words ||delta Z||_infinity <=2 sum_(s,F)||delta v_(s,F)||_infinity.

If every stored moment has coefficient error at most epsilon, the bound is2^(m+2)epsilon:8epsilon,16epsilon,32epsilon. Common normalized mixtures preserve the same bound. It holds for arbitrarily long words when subsequent observer updates are exact; new per-step roundoff and additional actions need their own estimate. The use of all-word normal forms avoids artificially multiplying a one-step factor2 at each step.

If the invariant sector is known, only four moments are needed and the old8epsilon bound applies. For mixtures of distinct eta-sectors the correct larger conditional state is used. Count/total/dominant positive weight requires the24- or48-bin CWM carrier, not these moments alone. Explicit independent choices among U1,U2,C with positive weights1/3 were compared with that exact quotient; after n commands a unit initial path has CWM=(3^n,1,3^-n). Fixed bin count does not imply fixed bit cost. The new results establish faithful representation rather than runtime acceleration.

entries.summary_zh: 既有六通道联络的闭路传输缩成Z/2关系位，T_γ=U_y P^ρ U_x^−1；每路径平方和可完全保真而固定star读出改变。结构等变不等于沿联络处处平行；一致重标保持读出差。单输入增量仅到其对边，不能把背景六项置换说成一项牵动五项。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 1. 目标、来源与已获得的对应
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 1. 目标、来源与已获得的对应

目标是把前轮“稳定读数仍可携带一个关系位”的结果接回有既有源码与审查记录的模型，而不是再增设一份三元预留规则库。

本轮读取并消费 V18 已有有限 K4 联络正例：
- research_returns/P000_LOCAL_TO_GLOBAL_BACKGROUND_EQUIVARIANCE_V18_RETURN_20260831.md，blob 9ef58775c372f1019d3c1d0f1a6bd84565374e90；
- research_checks/P000_LOCAL_TO_GLOBAL_BACKGROUND_EQUIVARIANCE_V18_CHECK_20260831.py，blob 32aa00fd8f36b7c5bf5285e4cec79499dec87509；
- driver_reviews/P000_LOCAL_TO_GLOBAL_BACKGROUND_EQUIVARIANCE_V18_DRIVER_REVIEW_20260831.md，blob 581a53c11867fdb8e3f8f346381603c2c146d86d。

审查确认的是该有限 K4 非平坦且 S4 等变联络及其验证接口强度。三角闭路非恒等是继承事实，不作为本轮新发现重复计功。本轮新增：在正 CWM BRC 中执行其精确关系提升；给出任意路径的端点—奇偶标准形；接入源码已有 star/PF_GLOBAL 观察结构；证明等变性与沿联络平行的一项具体不相容；给出平方和零缺陷但读出非零差异的实际证书。

六个通道是桥接载体通道，不直接宣称是六个原生空间坐标。K4 节点及三角路径是该有限模型的对象；这里没有提供原生空间嵌入、真实作用/反作用、材料位移或物理时钟。原生六轴、120 度 PERP_E、P000 与既定平方和定义均保留。新增结论的独立审查状态不从旧审查继承。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 2. 精确源输入和 BRC 提升
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 2. 精确源输入和 BRC 提升

源码规定 V={A,B,C,D}，六通道依次为
E1=AB, E2=AC, E3=AD, E4=BC, E5=BD, E6=CD。
相对通道对为 (E1,E6)、(E2,E5)、(E3,E4)。

沿载体边 e=(x,y)，T_xy 交换通道 e 与其唯一相对边通道，其他通道不动；反向边使用同一个对合。路径传输按这些操作的先后组合定义。源 PF_GLOBAL 的 s_x 是与节点 x 相接的三个通道的指示函数。

将每个置换 T 转成有向关系核 K_T：对输入通道 i，唯一允许输出是 T(i)，系数 CWM_ONE。实际复合为
(K_S * K_T)(i,k)=⊕_j K_T(i,j)⊗K_S(j,k)，
其中 ⊗ 调用原 cwm_propagate，⊕ 调用原 cwm_recoalesce。

每个 i 恰有一个非零中间项，因此复合关系精确等于 K_(S∘T)。这给出有限置换源语义到已有正权 BRC 的保真提升，不是先运行普通矩阵传播再改名。信号保留 (原始来源标签,当前通道) 键；路线作为输入词及证书保留。正质量之间的差只在观察比较时出现。

已有 BRC 原文件 blob=3f205696709e847909958a153f8fe10d3f6b70f0。加载器只去掉当前测试不调用的 brc_logarithm/exact_arithmetic 相对导入，所有函数和类 AST 原样核对。旧 V18 顶层检查器包含其他计算，本轮只读其源码，不执行旧检查器或旧预留模型整套测试。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 3. 从三角闭路到全部路径：一个精确关系位
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 3. 从三角闭路到全部路径：一个精确关系位

定义 P=(E1 E6)(E2 E5)(E3 E4)。任何三角路径恰涉及三个不同相对边对，故总传输为 P；P²=id。互相回退的一对边消去为恒等。

任意闭路不仅包括简单三角。取 U_A=id、U_x=T_Ax（x≠A），并令 ε_A=0，ε_x=1（x≠A）。直接按边类型检查可得

T_xy = U_y P^(1+ε_x+ε_y) U_x，指数在模 2 中计算。

U_x 都是上述三个互不干扰的对合之一，与 P 交换。沿 γ=(x0,...,xn) 相邻 U_x² 消去，得到

T_γ = U_xn P^(n+ε_x0+ε_xn) U_x0。

因此所有基于任意同一节点的闭路满足

T_γ=P^(n mod 2)。

从固定 A 出发时，当前通道传输由终点 y 和 ρ=n mod2 精确确定：T_γ=U_y P^(ρ+ε_y)。给定原始信号，只保留这两个活动字段便能恢复本模型当前传输，继续一步更新为 (y,ρ)→(z,ρ⊕1)。这是八状态关系提升；ρ不是空间维度，也不是物理时间。如果原系统已经保留步数奇偶，就已具有该信息，无需另造独立记忆。

奇闭路到达相同基节点而落在另一关系状态，偶闭路复原。若某观察能区分 v 与 Pv，单纯端点摘要不能保真，两个关系状态确实必要。这里是固定源及约定观察语言的结论；完整历史/来源查询的保全要求另行保留。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 4. 平方和可以完全保真，固定读出仍可改变
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 4. 平方和可以完全保真，固定读出仍可改变

对正信号的六个通道总量 v_i，定义本轮代数诊断 Q_C(v)=Σ_i v_i²。它不是未经桥接即称为原生长度或能量；平方和由原 CWM 串联/合流计算，乘积是明示的双线性观察，不是把同一概率分支权重误平方。

每个源操作是通道置换，所以对任意路径 Q_C(T_γv)=Q_C(v)。所有通道的总 CWM 也不变。

采用双参数输入 v_A(a,b)=(a,a,a,b,b,b)。三角闭路给出
Pv_A(a,b)=v_A(b,a)。

只要 a≠b，六个通道总量都变化，但总量 3(a+b) 和平方和 3(a²+b²) 完全相同。a=1,b=2 的实算为
(1,1,1,2,2,2)→(2,2,2,1,1,1)，总 W=9，Q_C=15。
第二圈给出 P²，逐来源信号也原样复原。

源模型已有固定 star 观察器 s_A，读出 R_A(v)=v_1+v_2+v_3。故第一圈后读数从 3a 变为 3b；例中由 3 变 6。两次读出的 CWM 分别为(C3,W3,M1)和(C3,W6,M2)，互补三个通道的质量一起保留，总质量仍为 9。没有后选择或丢弃后归一化。

所以这个模型的度量型缺陷为零，而关系型差异及固定观察差异不为零。给平方和追加一个 ε 不能替代记录当前哪组三通道承载 a、哪组承载 b。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 5. 对称性并不要求沿联络处处不变
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 5. 对称性并不要求沿联络处处不变

源 star family 满足结构 S4 等变：重标节点与通道后 s_x 变成 s_gx。这是空间结构重标下的自然性。

本轮从同一源 star 推出一整族 f_x(a,b)=a s_x+b(1-s_x)，其结构等变性对所有 a,b 都成立。另一方面，对每条边 x→y，有

T_xy s_x = 1-s_y，
T_xy f_x(a,b)=f_y(b,a)。

因此在这族中，如果另要求“给定场沿此联络平行”，即 T_xy f_x=f_y 对所有边成立，必要充分条件就是 a=b。

这是额外性质的精确判定，并不把平行条件强加给源模型。非恒定等变场和等变联络可以作为不同结构共存，却不能因此推断前者沿后者处处不变。若为消除关系残差强制 a=b，得到的是丢掉双参数对比的特殊子族，而不是一般安全压缩。

更一般地，对任意信号 v，有 R_y(T_xy v)=S(v)-R_x(v)，其中 S 为总 W。故仅使用随节点固定 star 读出时，读数每步在 R 和 S-R 之间交换。当前 R=S/2 的输入在该受限观察语言中看不到关系位，即使六通道排列确已改变。例如 (1,2,3,1,2,3) 与其 P 像都给 star 读数6，但完整通道向量不同。当前可见性始终依赖观察语言。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 6. 排除“只是换标签”的假差异
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 6. 排除“只是换标签”的假差异

若进行同一坐标/通道重标 h，则信号变成 hv，闭路核变成 hPh⁻¹，固定观察器也相应改写为 R∘h⁻¹。因此
(R∘h⁻¹)(hPh⁻¹ hv)=R(Pv)。

a=1,b=2 的 3→6 差异在整个装置一致重标后不变；只重标信号却不相应重标观察器是另一个操作，不能混用。P非恒等的事实也不能被共轭成恒等。代码用全部720种六通道基点重标检查了这张关系图。它们作为表示重标测试，不推断720种操作都是原生物理许可的旋转。

此外，P不属于源码的结构 S4 六边表示：结构顶点置换把 star 变成 star，P却把 star 变成对面的三边三角。这个 P 来自独立联络，而不是给结构 S4 悄悄增添一个已获原生身份的旋转。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 7. 六项变化与“一项输入牵动五项”仍是不同问题
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 7. 六项变化与“一项输入牵动五项”仍是不同问题

本轮的闭路确能同时改变六个通道。但对相同闭路只增加一个输入通道的正信号 δe_i，BRC 线性性给
P(v+δe_i)-Pv=δe_opp(i)。

因此这份独立联络本身的单通道输入敏感性是置换型：新增信号只到达一个相对通道，不是稠密五向分流。程序逐一用 δ=1/3 的额外独立来源信号验证六个输入通道，未把其他通道的背景置换混称为该新增信号导致的变化。

若希望从这里证明原生单轴力使其他五轴变化，需要另外取得实际多通道相互作用、原生坐标读出和作用/反作用。这个明确欠项比泛称“还缺完整力学”更小：已有联络提供关系输运和可观察残差；尚缺将单输入分配/反馈到多个原生读出的动力学对应。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 8. 多路径的正权保真与有限检查
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 8. 多路径的正权保真与有限检查

明示三条路线：空路线权重1/5、一次三角权重3/10、两圈三角权重1/2。规范化的是路线准备，其初始信号仍总 W=9。按关系位合流，ρ=0的CWM为(C2,W7/10,M1/2)，ρ=1为(C1,W3/10,M3/10)。逐路线完整传播与先合并关系位后传播的每通道 C/W/M 完全相同；固定 star 的加权读数为39/10。源路线表仍保存，活动压缩只为不查询被省略路线身份的声明观察服务。

实际22,399项断言包括：24个结构顶点置换的源核自然性；24个有向三角；12条边的逆向与标准形；从A出发长度0至8的全部9,841条路径；16组(a,b)及12条边的平行判别；720种基点重标；729组六通道正预算；6个单通道增量；完整与关系位压缩的正CWM对应。

实际BRC调用cwm_edge=22523、cwm_propagate=202874、cwm_recoalesce=346757。一般任意路径结论由标准形证明保证，不由有限路径数量外推。两次同作者进程（不同Python哈希种子）最终输出逐字一致；不称独立审查。

完整results.json为43339字节，SHA256=80b82fa5cb1f83a1562e76e78ba211f3c076f947c1bfd65cc263d16da19fa495。所有短路径明细、示例逐来源轨迹、分组检查计数及完整输入生成规则均保留。穷尽长路径的逐项结果用顺序摘要与可再生代码保存，不声称保存了所有运行内存。

entries.title: 五目标共同响应：成对 BRC 证书、三元扇出与不可识别边界
entries.summary_zh: 处理/对照成对载体共享同准备和外部seed，正CWM权重只附一次。一次局部释放加三次不重叠跨模块重组可让同一分支五目标共同变化；相同单项/两两响应不足以给共同概率。Fréchet界max(0,Σp_j−4)≤θ≤min p_j；每事件至多触三模块时五目标至少需三事件，非物理时间下界。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 1. 增量与边界
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 1. 增量与边界

继承上一轮实际干预与条件筛选的区别，本轮不重做旧套件，直接区分五项平均响应、每项目标有变化的权重、同一成对分支五项共同变化。构造只调用既有 reserve/release 的三元预留接口，不新定义原生力或物理传播器。

六模块由36个发生标识分组，每模块六个成员；不是六条原生空间轴。发生编号、占用位、事件数量都不是 Cell 坐标或能量。P000、六轴 PERP_E、120度、平方和与世界观未改变。对 TRIADIC_CLOSURE_E 的当前 GitHub 查询返回 incomplete_results=true、items=[]，只能记检索覆盖不完整，不作全仓库没有原生模型的结论。本轮没有取得原生作用/坐标读出映射。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 2. 成对载体：权重只计算一次
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 2. 成对载体：权重只计算一次

对固定完整准备 x 和共同外部命令种子 omega，定义对照和处理后继：s0=G_omega(x)，s1=G_omega(A_i(x))。配对来源是相同 x、omega，而不是随便把两个独立运行相乘。确定性输入没有种子歧义；随机系统使用共同种子本身是必须声明、并由实际模型支持的耦合假设。

成对载体保留 (x,omega,s0,s1,原命令词及标记)，其系数就是该准备支路的原正 CWM 权重 w(x,omega)。一次共同命令作用在两个分量上，但不把 w 乘成 w^2。原 cwm_propagate 承载命令接续，cwm_recoalesce 只合并相同保留键的备选来源。每个处理/对照投影分别恢复原完整输入的同规则演化。没有克隆物理资源或把两个世界当成同时存在的材料。

对五个声明目标读出，定义 d_j=o_j(s1)-o_j(s0)，M_j=1[d_j!=0]。有符号 d 只是两个正输出的比较，不是负质量。联合响应谱 Gamma(M) 是按五位 M 分组的 CWM。对规范化 W 定义 p_j=W(M_j=1)，theta=W(M=(1,1,1,1,1))。

有限正权支路中，theta>0说明存在共同变化分支；theta=1说明该准备/程序全部正权分支共同变化。五个平均差 E[d_j] 非零、五个 p_j 非零，都不等于 theta>0。平均差为零也不等于没有分支变化。Gamma 只是固定终端响应诊断，不是支持任意未来操作的完整状态压缩；完整成对来源继续保留。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 3. 正面构造：一次源释放，三次资源不重叠的跨模块重组
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 3. 正面构造：一次源释放，三次资源不重叠的跨模块重组

库存 I={1,...,36}，模块 g=0,...,5 分别拥有6g+1至6g+6。初态只有当前事件 {1,2,3}，其他成员空闲。局部处理 A=release(1) 在第一模块内释放该完整三元事件；对照不做这项释放。

共同后续 G 依次执行：

G1=reserve({1,7,13}); G2=reserve({2,19,25}); G3=reserve({3,31,32})。

目标读出是成员 (7,13,19,25,31) 的占用。对照中1、2、3仍被原事件占用，所以三次新提案都阻挡，目标为00000。处理中1、2、3空闲，三个新事件两两不重叠，全部合法加入，目标为11111。处理最终三个事件仍是三元复合网络，不是高元原子事件。

全部六种命令顺序相同。这里的“共同”指同一配对来源的最终五项对照差，不声称同一个物理时刻或瞬时传播。源模块自身的占用末态恢复为1、2、3都占用，但成员关联已经改变，故占用恢复不等于完整状态返回。

若在相同库存中额外准备阻挡事件 {7,8,9}，G1两边都受阻，最终共同变化掩码为00111；G2/G3仍产生效果。相同候选连接图不保证通道在该状态实际生效。

该构造首次在本研究链中给出资源不重复、同一分支五目标共同变化的具体程序；不是原生六轴作用的实验证明。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 4. 相同单项及两两响应，仍不能确定五项共同响应
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 4. 相同单项及两两响应，仍不能确定五项共同响应

把三个执行开关 omega=(a,b,c) 明确包含在初始外部上下文；它们只决定固定提案执行或跳过，不按结果筛选。对照与处理使用完全相同的开关。由上例得到

M(omega)=(a,a,b,b,c)。

输入 E 取000,011,101,110，各1/4；输入 O 取001,010,100,111，各1/4。是两个不同的完整联合准备，不冒称同一微观初态；两者使用相同 primitive 规则与固定门序。

每个输出的 p_j 都是1/2。来自同一开关的输出对同时变化权重1/2，来自不同开关的输出对为1/4，故全部两两响应统计也完全相同。但共同响应要求a=b=c=1：theta_E=0，theta_O=1/4。若共同开关只取000/111各1/2，则五项p仍相同而theta=1/2。原始质量全保留，失败/跳过分支不消失。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 5. 五项共同变化的严格概率界
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 5. 五项共同变化的严格概率界

对任意规范化正 W 成对族，不需要独立性：

max(0, sum_j p_j - 4) <= theta <= min_j p_j。

上界因共同事件包含于每个单项事件；下界由共同事件的补集是五个失败事件的并集及并集上界得到。这是对原正权输出的读出恒等/不等式，不构造负支路。

界的可达性例子使用明确的诊断掩码族而非原生物理准备：五条“恰有一项不变”掩码各权重1/5，得到p_j=4/5而theta=0；全部变化权重4/5、全部不变权重1/5，则同样p_j=4/5而theta=4/5。共同变化权重1/2、五条恰缺一项各1/10，则p_j=9/10、theta=1/2，达到正的下界。

给定边缘且没有更多联合结构时，不能从五项各有80%响应就断言存在共同响应。若掌握更强联合关系，可以得到更强的特定界；这里没有宣称此粗界利用了全部模型约束。

若近似的是同一完整成对W分布，TV误差至多epsilon，则任何固定Gamma事件特别是theta的误差也至多epsilon。这沿用上轮同核读出不放大结论；不包括动力学误差、读出映射错误或错配对照/处理。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 6. 成对来源不可从分别观测的末态分布凭空恢复
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 6. 成对来源不可从分别观测的末态分布凭空恢复

以下是耦合不可识别性见证，不是声称同一已固定动力学同时具有两种配对。对照、处理的五位末态分布都为00000和11111各1/2。两种联合配对都满足这两份完整边缘：

I: (00000,00000),(11111,11111)，各1/2；
F: (00000,11111),(11111,00000)，各1/2。

I中p_j=theta=0，F中p_j=theta=1；但两边五项平均差全为0，处理/对照的完整末态分布也完全相同。因此仅有两份末态资料不确定“同一分支是否变化”；必须有合法的逐源配对、确定性演化或明确结构耦合假设。不能用任意共同随机数仿真冒充已校准的物理反事实配对。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 7. 事件数量下界不等于物理时间下界
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 7. 事件数量下界不等于物理时间下界

额外假设完整状态能按模块分解，比较两次运行的初态只在源模块不同；每次共同操作的完整读取与写入范围 S 至多三个模块，既不暗读远端内场，也没有未计入的全局控制。固定外部种子保持相同。

保守影响集合 C0={源}。某操作S若与C不交，两边所读完整局部输入相同，更新相同，不产生新区别；若相交，最多加入S\C中的两个新模块。故经过m个跨模块事件，有 |Cm|<=1+2m。五个其他模块若最终都不同，影响集合必须至少包含源及这五个目标，因此m>=3。

上例的模块支持是{0,1,2},{0,3,4},{0,5}，影响集合大小依次1,3,5,6，三次事件达到该假设下的数量下界。G3虽涉及两个模块，但仍是三个发生的事件。

这不是“三次心跳”的证明。事件可并行；“三项作用参与闭合”也不自动推出“完整读取/写入仅限三个模块”。带隐藏场、公共控制器或非局部约束的规则必须把其依赖纳入完整支持，否则不可引用此界。连通性只给可能影响范围，不证明实际非零响应。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 8. 已执行的范围
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 8. 已执行的范围

原check_membership.py blob be1b60446e31c2c8489d1ce0db16cc1e952d11c8原字节加载；其依赖triad/router/brc_weighted的blob分别662755ef82c2f433ca57da76b4ce44d63a407612、7465f5aa16cbb8fba61ba4be80f8a6884b879c53、3f205696709e847909958a153f8fe10d3f6b70f0。旧main未执行；沿用其有界加载方式，不称整个仓库回归。

本轮12605项主断言、396项实际调用的继承辅助断言；384种(8开关×8阻挡×6顺序)协议完整记录；3504个规范化诊断掩码族；三种端点可达性例子；两种耦合；0/1/2事件全部1/20/400个三模块支持词。实际BRC调用edge7359、propagate3377、recoalesce43501。无随机抽样、浮点参考传播、原生力学或物理实验。一般结论有自足推导，不由有限断言数量外推。

完整results.json为1774298字节，SHA256 a356cfc8d5156f08ffdabd26a266432774b3fb57343f248a7559d16adbcf1ba8。保留完整384协议的初态、逐步成对状态、成功/阻挡/跳过、谱与边界证书；大量两掩码混合检查以输入规则及结果摘要哈希再生，不宣称所有内存对象均已序列化。完整输出在会话包，项目代码及固定依赖可以重建；独立审查未执行。

entries.title: 残差补丁的操作顺序：非交换、条件抑制与排程保真
entries.summary_zh: reserve/release在当前匹配层幂等但非可逆；释放/释放、添加/添加、释放/添加的交换有逐状态完整判据。正成对末态记录顺序差，不用负质量。纯添加的所有排程末态恰为初始可用事件的极大不交子族；释放可通过竞争抑制目标，五目标并非对任意排程稳健。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 1. 续接范围
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 1. 续接范围

前轮构造三个互不争用发生的重组门，源释放后同一配对分支五个目标一起变化。本轮不重跑旧套件，不重新证明旧边缘/联合分布反例，而是明确：实际命令何时可以交换？竞争是否可以使释放的下游效果为负？同一门库的执行顺序是否改变五目标共同响应？

仍使用原 TEST_ONLY 三元预留模型。有限库存 I 上，J 为互不相交的三元素集合族；成员编号是发生标识，不是空间轴、Cell坐标或能量。所有 release/reserve 调用来自原 check_membership.py，所有支路串联/重合来自原正 CWM BRC。没有新增原生力学转移，没有把释放预留解释成物理闭合可逆。

原生资料核对改用明确入口而非重复不完整代码搜索：global 的 00_CURRENT_FOUNDATION.md 及 P000_NATIVE_FCC_STRICT_BRIDGE.json 当前原文描述载体 S4、背景保持和独立联络的条件；它们不提供本预留模型到六轴位移/受力的对应。不得用旧路由内的历史 CLAIMABLE 标记领取任务，也不将局部未取得映射夸大成全仓库没有原生模型。P000、PERP_E、120度、平方和、空间维数及世界观不变。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 2. 当前状态上的作用代数，与完整记录的区别
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 2. 当前状态上的作用代数，与完整记录的区别

令 U(J) 为当前已占用发生集合。对三元素集合 D，C_D(J) 在 D 与 U(J) 不交时加入 D，否则保持 J 并记录阻挡。R_b(J) 删除唯一包含 b 的当前事件；b 已空闲则保持 J。以下代数等式只比较当前状态 J 的末态，不删除另存的动作记录，也不包括命令次数、形成历史或未定义的物理代价。

有 C_D^2=C_D、R_b^2=R_b，但它们不是恒等映射。例如 C_123 将空态与 {123} 都映到 {123}；R_1 将空态与 {123} 都映到空态。故这些作用在当前状态层非单射，没有双侧逆。

严格代数后果：包含这些非恒等幂等元的作用幺半群不能忠实嵌入一个群。若嵌入 phi 保持组合，则 phi(C_D)^2=phi(C_D)，在群中消去得到 phi(C_D)=e=phi(id)，违反单射。故最初保留路径顺序的群扩张，不能在保持这些末态作用等式的同时直接成为全部当前预留操作的忠实群模型。可以另行添加历史寄存器研究可逆实现；该可能性不被此定理排除，且不证明物理时间不可逆。

完整记录不满足上述删步许可：同一事件123上先释放1后释放2，成功标记属于1；逆序则属于2。末态同为空，按成员标注的记录不同。重复一次命令也增加记录长度。因此幂等性/交换性证书必须声明比较的观察层。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 3. 两条命令交换的完整状态判据
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 3. 两条命令交换的完整状态判据

记 f_D(J)=1[D与U(J)不交]。下文 F_b F_a 表示先a后b。

(1) 对任意 b,c，R_b R_c(J)=R_c R_b(J)。若二者属同一事件，第一条删除它、第二条空操作；若属不同事件，分别删除；空闲情况同理。仅保证末态，不保证中间记录相同。

(2) C_D 与 C_E 在 J 上不交换，当且仅当 D!=E、D交E非空、f_D(J)=f_E(J)=1。
证明：两者都可用且争用时，先到者加入并永久阻挡另一者，两个末态保留不同事件。若某个初始受阻，仅加入操作不能使它恢复可用；只有另一个可能加入，因此顺序无关。不争用及相同D的情况直接成立。

(3) 令 J^-=R_b(J)。C_D 与 R_b 在 J 上不交换，当且仅当
[f_D(J)=1 且 b属于D] 或 [f_D(J)=0 且 f_D(J^-)=1]。
证明：若D初始可用而b在D内，先加入后释放会删除新D，先释放后加入则留下D；b不在D内时两个动作互不影响。若D初始受阻，先加入必空操作，随后只剩J^-；另一顺序只有在释放清除了D的全部阻挡时才多出D。

注意：命令表面的参数不相交，不代表实际支撑不相交。J={123}，release(1) 与 reserve(245) 的显式成员参数不重叠，但前者也释放2；先释放再加入能得到245，反序加入被阻挡、再释放只剩空态。上一轮任何“每门读取/写入范围”的传播计数界必须包括成员查找与完整事件依赖，不能只看命令中的一个数字。

实现对六发生全部31种当前装配和26种原始命令（6释放+20加入）逐一验证所有20956个有序命令对；另查806个单命令幂等情形。一般判据来自上述分类证明，而非枚举外推。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 4. 顺序残差的正载体与安全换序
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 4. 顺序残差的正载体与安全换序

对完整当前状态s和两条命令a,b，保留成对末态
D_ab(s)=(F_b F_a(s), F_a F_b(s))，
若要观察r再取r(F_bF_a(s))-r(F_aF_b(s))。后者的符号是两个正输出之间的比较，不是负支路质量。只保存某个标量差，不能代替这个差异对任意后续操作的影响。

BRC命令核使用原CWM系数；串联沿中间状态传播，备选按相同保留键重合。若在所有有关可达输入上a,b的完整后继核相等，且后续不读取被省略的命令记录，则换序后的任何相同后缀末态观察相同。确定性模型的逐状态相等可以按原分配律提升到正CWM分支族。若仅在一个给定状态相等，只授予该前缀处的换序，不能宣布普遍交换律；完整过程记录是更强观察。

静态兼容装配乘法与命令串联不能混型。静态乘法排除不兼容共同选择；运行命令即使受阻也保留当前状态及阻挡记录。前者的兼容无序并集可以交换，不推出后者的条件执行可以交换。补丁应位于有类型的状态转移层，而不是任意修改整数算术。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 5. 新反例：释放资源反而抑制目标
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 5. 新反例：释放资源反而抑制目标

固定原库 A=123、B=145、C=456。相同初态J={A}。对照不释放；处理先R_1。共同后续先尝试B、再尝试C；目标读出为成员6是否占用。

对照：B因1占用而受阻；C的456都空闲，C加入，末态{A,C}，读数1。
处理：R_1释放A；B率先占用145；C因4、5被B占用而受阻，末态{B}，读数0。
所以同源处理减对照为-1。支路预算仍为正1；不是负质量抵消。

把共同后续交换为先C后B，两边C都首先加入、B都被4/5阻挡，目标读数同为1，差为0。额外释放扩大即时空闲集合，不保证固定竞争过程的每个下游读数单调增加。没有加入优化器，没有删除失败分支，也没有数值误差。

若显式算法排程以alpha概率取B先C、其余取C先B，则负响应概率alpha、平均对照差-alpha。alpha仅是声明的排程准备；本轮核对0、1/5、1/2、4/5、1，不能将其指定为原生概率。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 6. 任意有限纯加入清单的排程定理
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 6. 任意有限纯加入清单的排程定理

固定J，每个不同支撑的候选三元事件各尝试一次，后续没有释放或事件删除。令H0是初始就与U(J)不交的候选集合。

定理：所有排列得到的末态，恰为J加上H0中所有极大不相交子族。这里极大指不能再添加，不是事件数最多。
证明：初始受阻的事件不会被后续加入释放。每条排列选择出不相交子族；没加入的每个H0事件在其尝试时已与某个永久保留的已选事件冲突，故末子族极大。反过来任一极大子族M可以先逐一尝试M的成员，再尝试其余；前者全加入，后者都被M阻挡。于是每个极大子族都可实现。

推论：在完整成员装配末态层，对所有排列结果相同，当且仅当H0中所有不同事件两两不相交。充分性直接；若D,E冲突，分别让D或E最先尝试，它们在各自结果中永久留下，不可能有同一个末态同时包含二者。

排程概率不是末态等概率。空态上事件123/145/456的六种等权排列，4种得到{123,456}、2种得到{145}。末态CWM分别(C=4,W=2/3,M=1/6)及(C=2,W=1/3,M=1/6)。把两个末态平均为1/2会丢掉排程来源与重数。

计算核对六发生的全部1140组三事件库、固定库的31个初态及一个九发生三事件完全不相交正例，总1172个案例、7032条三命令排列；极大子族由原BRC静态装配独立产生作逐项对应。未运行旧main。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 7. 五目标构造加入竞争后不再排程稳健
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 7. 五目标构造加入竞争后不再排程稳健

沿用前轮36发生、源J={123}、目标(7,13,19,25,31)，共同门为G1=1713、G2=21925、G3=33132（实际代码均存三元组，串写只在此作名称简记）。精确支撑分别为{1,7,13}、{2,19,25}、{3,31,32}。新增同类候选H={1,7,19}，不改变原操作核。

对照中三个源成员仍被A占用，四个门全受阻。处理中若H先于G1和G2，它先占用1、7、19，阻挡G1/G2，G3仍成功；五目标差分为10101。若G1或G2在H前成功，则阻挡H，原三个门都可完成，五目标差分为11111。G3与它们不争用。

完整检查四门全部24种排列：16种11111，8种10101。均匀排列诊断的共同响应权重2/3，但未知实际排程时，只能说存在全响应排列，也存在不全响应排列；不能凭这项均匀实验宣称物理共同响应概率2/3。对这个新模型，最坏排程共同响应为0，最好为1。三元作用数量、静态连通性和正预算均不能替代排程稳健性证明。

“最小扰动”还需声明选择规律/控制过程；不能把求最优时由算法选择的顺序当成自然已执行的顺序。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 1. Scope and unchanged inputs
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 1. Scope and unchanged inputs

This continues the previous order-dependent five-target example. It does not repeat the old order-commutation suite or treat old contributors as independent reviewers. On a finite occurrence inventory I, a current state J is a family of pairwise disjoint triples. reserve(D) adds D if all its members are unoccupied, otherwise keeps the state and a blocked outcome. release(b) removes the unique current triple containing b, or does nothing if b is free. All executed operations use the unchanged pinned membership kernel and its positive CWM BRC dependencies.

Occurrence IDs, modules, occupancy bits, library size and command counts are NOT native spatial axes, final Cell addresses, energy, force or physical time. The added triple K below is a declared extension of this TEST_ONLY library, not a new primitive update rule and not a proven native closure. P000, the six axes, PERP_E, 120 degrees, the specified squared-length readout and protected worldview remain unchanged.

The actual current source definition P000_DISCRETE_DIRECTION_TRIADIC_BALANCE_20260905.md, blob f95fd7a935ce16c875ac2756b299dfe2b7d9c8e5, distinguishes triadic arity from the legality of concrete Cell/direction closures. It supplies no license to assert that this particular K is a physical force event. No repository-wide absence claim is made.

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 2. General target-blocking certificate
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 2. General target-blocking certificate

Fix an initial state J0 and a finite list H of distinct candidate triples, each attempted exactly once in arbitrary order, with no releases during the list. Remove candidates meeting U(J0); call the remaining initially available family H0. The inherited schedule theorem says that the possible selected families are exactly the maximal disjoint subfamilies of H0. Maximal means inclusion-maximal, not maximum cardinality.

Let t be initially free and H_t={h in H0:t in h}. Then:

Every complete ordering occupies t
iff
there is NO disjoint family M contained in H0\H_t whose union meets every h in H_t.

Proof. If a maximal selected family leaves t free, it contains no h in H_t. Each such h must meet a selected event, otherwise it could still be added. This gives M. Conversely, start with any such M and extend it to a maximal disjoint family using only H0\H_t. All h in H_t remain blocked by the original M, so the extension is maximal in all H0 and leaves t free. Attempt its selected events first to obtain an explicit failing order. If H_t is empty, the empty M is a valid certificate; if t is initially occupied, it is already robust under reserve-only updates.

A certificate can always be reduced to at most |H_t| events: for each h choose one intersecting event from M and retain only the selected witnesses. They remain disjoint. Thus only competitors that meet some target-containing candidate are needed for a failure certificate. This is a local input restriction for this theorem, NOT a general efficient algorithm or a spatial locality law.

For a finite set T of initially free targets, all targets are occupied in every complete ordering iff the above certificate is absent for every t in T. This exchanges two universal quantifiers; it is not an inference from positive marginal response probabilities.

The checker verifies the criterion for all 4,845 four-event libraries on six occurrences, with 29,070 target questions and independently represented maximal assemblies from the original BRC algebra. An additional occupied initial state checks initial availability filtering. This is a finite implementation test; the proof above provides the general statement.

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 3. One complementary triple repairs the old competition
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 3. One complementary triple repairs the old competition

The inventory is I={1,...,36}; the initial source event is A={1,2,3}. Targets are T=(7,13,19,25,31). The retained old candidates are:

G1={1,7,13}; G2={2,19,25}; G3={3,31,32}; H={1,7,19}.

A control keeps A; a treatment executes the same actual release(1) as before. Every subsequent candidate is attempted in the same order in both runs. In the control, every candidate meets the still occupied source A and is blocked.

The old treatment has a bad maximal family {H,G3}, leaving 13 and 25 free. Add exactly:

K={2,13,25}.

The four candidates G1,G2,H,K have two disjoint pairs: {G1,G2} and {H,K}. Every event in the first pair conflicts with every event in the second. G3 is disjoint from all four. Whichever of the four is first selects its side, whose other member remains available and will be selected; the opposite side is blocked. G3 is always selected.

Hence ALL complete orderings end in exactly one of:

J_L={G1,G2,G3}; J_R={H,K,G3}.

Their full occupied occurrence sets are identical:

U_*={1,2,3,7,13,19,25,31,32}.

Both have three active events and occupy all five targets. The control target vector is 00000; the treatment vector is 11111. Thus the paired joint response mask is 11111 for EVERY order. No uniform-order assumption is needed for this universal conclusion; any probability law supported on these complete orders gives theta=1.

All 120 orders were executed with complete paired intermediate traces. The uniform-order diagnostic uses each initial schedule weight once, not its square. Each internal terminal structure has C=60, W=1/2, M=1/120. The merged five-target response has C=120, W=1, M=1/120. Uniform scheduling is a diagnostic distribution, not a native probability law.

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 4. Minimality and uniqueness are precisely scoped
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 4. Minimality and uniqueness are precisely scoped

Keep the four old candidates, allow only additions, add one distinct triple from I, and require the new triple to meet A so that it remains source-gated in the control. Under these restrictions K is the UNIQUE repair, and one additional candidate is the minimum possible number.

Proof. Zero additions retains the old failure. Consider an order putting H and G3 before every other candidate. They are disjoint, so both form in the treatment. G1 and G2 are now permanently blocked, and targets 13 and 25 remain free. The one added triple must therefore contain BOTH 13 and 25 and be disjoint from H and G3. It must also meet A. Members 1 and 3 are occupied by H and G3 respectively, so its only possible source member is 2. Therefore it must be {2,13,25}. Section 3 proves sufficiency.

The original BRC assembly enumerator evaluated all 1,680 source-gated, nonduplicate single-addition candidates in the fixed 36-member inventory. K alone succeeds. Every other candidate has an explicit failing complete order, which was also executed. This does not prove minimal physical disturbance, energy, duration or edit distance under different allowed changes. Deleting H, changing the order rule or adding new primitive operations would be different optimization problems.

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 5. Stable readout does not erase the relation residual
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 5. Stable readout does not erase the relation residual

J_L and J_R have the same entire occupation and event count, but they are not the same current state. Apply the SAME next command release(7):

J_L -> {G2,G3}, target readout 00111;
J_R -> {K,G3}, target readout 01011.

In the first case 13 is freed and 19 remains occupied; in the second 19 is freed and 13 remains occupied. Therefore the equal-occupation projection is safe for this completed forward target question, but not for the enlarged future language containing release(7) and target observations.

On just this two-element terminal family, a single binary relation label rho distinguishing J_L and J_R is sufficient to reconstruct the full current J and hence initialize any subsequent inherited operation. It is necessary because the above future experiment distinguishes the two states. This is one bit for this known terminal family, not a claim that arbitrary future states or all six-axis systems forever need only one residual bit.

So residual-aware algebra can have an exactly stable coarse readout while retaining nonzero relational distinctions. No scalar correction to integer multiplication or the given squared-length formula has been established or required by this example.

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 6. More candidate events is not automatically a repair
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 6. More candidate events is not automatically a repair

After adding K, add another source-gated candidate L={1,2,7}. The order L,G3,G1,G2,H,K reaches {L,G3}; the target vector is 10001. L blocks all four cross-pair candidates. The universal guarantee is lost even though another apparent route was added.

All 720 orders of this six-candidate library were executed. Under uniform diagnostic scheduling, 576 give full response and 144 give 10001. No claim is made that these artificial probabilities describe native physics. The point is structural: one must eliminate all relevant blocking certificates, not merely add connections.

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 7. Availability and scheduling uncertainty remain separate
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 7. Availability and scheduling uncertainty remain separate

Suppose K has a declared independent availability flag with probability q; when unavailable its scheduled attempt is skipped. The old candidates are all attempted. With uniform complete ordering of the five named attempts:

theta_uniform(q)=2/3+q/3.

Conditional on K available the response is always complete. Conditional on it unavailable, the relative order of the four old attempts is uniform, retaining the inherited 2/3 diagnostic. For any fixed ordering, response probability is either 1 or q; an H-first ordering attains q. Thus the worst fixed-order guarantee is q, not 2/3+q/3. This distinction requires the declared flag law and completeness assumptions; it is not a native reliability law or physical clock.

The checker evaluated q=0,1/4,1/2,3/4,1 by positive BRC branching, retaining missing-route and blocked branches. It also validates total W=1. At q=0 the coefficient is CWM_ZERO, not an illegal positive edge of weight zero.

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:

Official arXiv:2211.01945v1 (Balliu/Brandt/Kuhn/Olivetti) describes maximal hypergraph matchings and sequential greedy construction. Official arXiv:2103.00729v1 discusses causal dependencies, conflicts and abstract processes in Petri nets. Only metadata and abstracts were read. No unexamined full-text theorem, distributed-round bound or physical timing claim is imported. General matching/concurrency theory is not claimed as a new invention.

The dedicated query on Issue3522, batch cbba6ce2-8af9-4ca3-a7de-e406ef304753, completed with one arXiv metadata/abstract result. Its request digest 11ff5e64ed02f09789fa2eca893725e97af3f0e1c31270c7ad2fccdfddf5b155 matched intake and result; retrieval_verified=true, provider total unknown. Full-text access and independent verification were not established by this receipt.

Next native question is now narrower than merely asking for a generic force law: does a sourced native configuration support BOTH complementary triadic decompositions, with the required action/reaction and six-axis readout correspondence? If only one decomposition is legal, this repair cannot be imported. If both are legal, check that every permitted completion covers the targets and retain the relation choice for later operations. No new native triple, scheduler or release law has been inferred from a convenient test.

entries.title: 关系残差的重组门槛：三元作用不保证统一小扰动
entries.summary_zh: 两满匹配的重组有所有路径的邻域门槛：首次达到k条新事件前空位≥3(|N(S)|−k+1)。同21成员可有精确峰值9或12；二维有限torus标签族给无界门槛。固定满占用纤维上的最小峰值满足对称性及强三角律，但不是原生二维空间或能量势垒。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 1. 范围及真实复用
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 1. 范围及真实复用

固定有限库存I和合法三元事件库H。状态J是互不相交的三元组族。reserve(D)仅在三个成员空闲时加入，否则记录阻挡并保持状态；release(b)释放当前包含b的整个事件，否则保持状态。实际执行原exchange_core的catalog/run/step/support_reachability及其未修改的membership、triad、packet_router、brc_weighted依赖。图算法只对原正CWM BRC的Boolean-support和整数资源观察计算，不把选出的最短路径当成完整分支概率。

发生编号、周期索引、空位和命令数量属于本组合模型，不代表原生空间轴、力、能量或物理时间。P000、120度PERP_E与既定六轴平方和保持原义。原生作用映射仍待建立。

对全占用端点，令c(J)=|I|-3|J|，路径峰值h(p)=max_{J沿p}c(J)，定义B_H(J,K)=min_{p:J到K}h(p)。有限库中可以全释放再按目标加入，故最小值存在。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 2. 任意路径的邻域门槛下界
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 2. 任意路径的邻域门槛下界

设A_0,...,A_(n-1)与B_0,...,B_(n-1)分别完整分组同一3n成员，且两边没有相同事件；H恰为它们的并。对新事件子族S，N(S)表示它们触及的旧A事件。

任意路径第一次使当前B事件数达到k时，记加入后的B集合为S。加入之前已有k-1条B，而且N(S)中的旧A全部不在场，否则本次加入无法成功。因此该步之前

    c >= 3(|N(S)|-k+1).

令beta_k=min_{|S|=k}(|N(S)|-k)，则

    B_H(allA,allB) >= 3 max_{1<=k<=n}(1+beta_k).

论证允许重新加入旧A、释放新B、回退和等待。不是仅对单调路径成立。

给定B的一个排列及前缀S_k，只在需要时释放与下一B冲突的旧A，再加入该B，准确峰值为3 max_k(|N(S_k)|-k+1)，命令数2n。对前缀作min-max动态规划得到最优单调路线；只有另有下界或完整图证书匹配时，才宣称任意路径最优。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 3. 同样21个成员，精确门槛由9变为12
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 3. 同样21个成员，精确门槛由9变为12

取n=7，令N(B_j)={A_j,A_(j+1),A_(j+3)}，下标模7。每条冲突图边对应独立发生，得到两侧各七个三元事件，共21成员。

任意两个不同B的旧邻域交恰一个A，故邻域并有五个A。第一次拥有两条B之前至少空出3(5-2+1)=12个成员。

按B6,B5,...,B0执行必要释放后加入，旧邻域前缀大小为3,5,6,7,7,7,7；加入前峰值分别9,12,12,12,9,6,3。原核14命令轨迹达到12。故最小空位峰值12，最少命令14。

原BRC生成全部458个合法状态。阈值9下源连通分量99状态，阈值12下373状态；目标仅在后者。检查保存了阈值9的完整源分量及其闭包。冲突图连通，每条边的全占用方程a_i+b_j=1强制仅全A/全B两个饱和态。因此它和前轮n=7循环族一样只有一位端点关系区别，但该族门槛12，旧循环族门槛9。旧结论在原范围内不变。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 4. 显式无界三元族及上下界
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 4. 显式无界三元族及上下界

以(i,j)属于(Z/mZ)^2作为有限邻接索引，m>=3。索引对不是原生二维平面。每个索引有三个发生，定义

    A_(i,j)={(i,j,0),(i,j,1),(i,j,2)},
    B_(i,j)={(i,j,0),(i-1,j,1),(i,j-1,2)}.

每侧n=m^2个三元事件，库存3m^2。连接图连通，饱和纤维仍仅全A/全B两态。对新事件索引S，有N(S)=S并(S-e1)并(S-e2)。

对偶数m>=4及|S|=m^2/2，令r为既非满又非空的行数。若r>=m/2，每一混合行的水平循环移位至少增加一个不同边界索引，故|N(S)|-|S|>=m/2。若r<m/2，则必须同时有满行和空行：没有满行会使|S|<=r(m-1)<m^2/2；对补集同理得到必须有空行。于是每列都是混合列，垂直循环移位每列至少新增一个索引，边界至少m。两种情况都给出

    B_H(allA,allB) >= 3(m/2+1).

此下界覆盖任意原命令路径。反向逐行加入B、逐项释放必要旧A，则每个非空前缀满足|N(S)|-|S|<=m。证明：前缀由k条完整连续行和下一行尾部p个索引组成；无完整行时盈余p+1<=m，有完整行时盈余至多m，最后一行只使盈余下降。因此存在2m^2命令原核路线，给出

    B_H(allA,allB) <= 3(m+1).

最小峰值为Theta(m)=Theta(sqrt(n))，绝对恢复工作空间无界，而占总库存比例为Theta(1/m)。原子事件始终三元；这不是能量或物理时间结论。

实际执行m=3,4,6,8,10,12的反向逐行路线。m=3完整状态图给出精确门槛12。m=4的全部65536个B子族由原BRC生成，其中12870个半数子族的最小邻域盈余4；下界15与构造上界15相等，故精确门槛15。m>=6报告上述证明界，不把构造上界宣称为精确最优。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 5. 强三角律和预算可达性分层
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 5. 强三角律和预算可达性分层

在固定全占用纤维上，每条成功reserve状态边都有对应release反向边，反之亦然。因此

    B(J,J)=0; B(J,K)=B(K,J);
    B(J,L)<=max(B(J,K),B(K,L)).

反转路径保留峰值；串联两条路径取峰值最大值。不同饱和端点必须暂时离开全占用，因此B>0。这是关系状态纤维上的超度量，不替代原生空间的六轴度量。一般非饱和端点B(J,J)=c(J)，不能直接称普通距离。每条状态边可反向，不意味着非单射操作函数具有全局逆。

B(J,K)<=b给出预算b下的可达性分组，随b增加合并。但预算内可互换不等于未来观察等价，仍不能借此删除关系标签。

两个不交库存组件的总空位相加，饱和端点间最小峰值却按max组合：投影到各组件给下界，逐个完成、其他组件保持饱和给上界。将门槛9的三组库与门槛12的七组库独立组合，原BRC生成全部6870状态并检验反向支撑。端点顺序00,01,10,11的准确门槛矩阵为

    0 12  9 12
   12  0 12  9
    9 12  0 12
   12  9 12  0

64个有序三端点关系均满足强三角律。预算9有两个连通类，预算12四者合并。

entries.title: 低重组门槛不保证快恢复：首次到达的正权 BRC 与 U20 观察分辨率推论
entries.summary_zh: n个独立六成员单元可保持重组空位峰值6，但均匀翻转到指定全R的首次到达期望随n指数增长。正BRC首次命中/存活质量与pointed长度矩分离。U20返回推论按具体状态与粗类观察区别义务；低重组门槛不推出快恢复或心跳时间。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 1. 本轮目标、来源和范围
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 1. 本轮目标、来源和范围

承接已有最小空位峰值 B_H，增加一个尚未由门槛回答的问题：在明确的正权执行规则下，到达指定关系需要多少次命令，以及截止次数内能否完成？

继续使用原始有限三元预留模型。reserve(D) 在 D 三个成员均空闲时加入该事件；release(b) 删除当前含 b 的整组三元事件。实际科学执行调用原 exchange_core.py 的 run/step/support_reachability，未修改 membership/triad/packet_router/brc_weighted。28份继承清单文件在本轮验证；旧 main 套件不执行。

新加入的是明确控制程序和首次到达观察，不是新的三元物理作用。发生标识不是空间轴；计数 n 不是空间维度。空位不是已定义能量，四命令轮次不是原子事件或物理心跳。P000、六轴 PERP_E、120度和已有平方和读数保持原义。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 2. 六空位双分组单元与 n 个不交副本
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 2. 六空位双分组单元与 n 个不交副本

一个单元的合法事件恰为 A1=123、A2=456、B1=124、B2=356。饱和分组只有 L={A1,A2} 与 R={B1,B2}，两者全部占用及事件数相同。

从 L 到 R 的实际命令是 release(1), release(4), reserve(124), reserve(356)。反向从 R 释放1、3所属事件，再加入123、456。每条路线的空位记录都是 0,3,6,3,0，四条命令均成功。两侧任一新事件跨越两条旧事件，所以任意原命令路径的第一个异侧事件成功前至少释放两条旧事件；最小峰值恰为6。

取 n 个互不相交的此类单元，第 i 个使用编号6i+1至6i+6。每个饱和状态由 n 位分组标签 x 指定，共2^n个饱和状态。所有这些状态有相同的6n成员占用和2n事件数。从全L到全R：逐单元完成四命令转换，峰值仍为6，命令数4n。每个初始事件都须释放、每个目标事件都须加入，因此4n是原操作语言下的最短长度。

此结论是本固定库的最小资源和最短路线；不替代前轮交错库的9、12或增长门槛。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 3. 明确执行律与合法的距离压缩
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 3. 明确执行律与合法的距离压缩

控制程序在每一完整轮次开始时，从 n 个单元均匀选一个，读取该单元的当前L/R，执行上述相应四命令，完成后才选择下一单元。每个选择独立，权重1/n。此控制器使用局部分组信息，其操作阶段和被选单元必须在四命令内部保留。它不是由P000推出的自然选择律。

在完整轮次边界，恰是每次翻转一位的无自环超立方体随机游走。目标为全R，初态全L。令d为尚未等于R的单元数。每个同d状态有d个向d-1的标签和n-d个向d+1的标签，每条标签权重1/n。因此对应CWM分别为

    (d, d/n, 1/n) 和 (n-d, (n-d)/n, 1/n)，

零条标签使用CWM_ZERO。对固定均匀控制律、距离及到达全R观察，这个压缩保留有限路径C/W/M。它不支持任意下一条指定成员释放或重建全体分组；对这类观察仍使用完整状态。

原命令逐项验证 n=1..8 的所有3586条边界状态/单元选择，合计510个边界状态。另对n=1,2的原单命令图做空位3/6可达性核对。选择权重只附一次，四条命令串联单位权重，不乘成(1/n)^4。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 4. 低门槛与指数首次到达：一般证明
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 4. 低门槛与指数首次到达：一般证明

令 tau 为首次达到全R的完整轮次数。令F_d为从距离d第一次到达d-1的路径族，e_d为其期望轮数。p_d=d/n，q_d=(n-d)/n。顶层F_n是一条必然向下的步骤。

在距离压缩的有效观察范围内，每条F_d路径唯一分解为零个或多个“向上一步，再首次回到d”的游程，接上一个向下步骤：

    F_d = (U_d F_(d+1))* D_d。

即计长度的正系数生成函数满足

    f_n(z)=z； f_d(z)=p_d z / (1-q_d z f_(d+1)(z))。

在z=1，递归的每一游程总量q_d<1，原one_state_recurrent_cwm给出收敛TOTAL闭包，归纳f_d(1)=1。长度一阶矩满足

    e_n=1； p_d e_d=1+q_d e_(d+1)。

这证明每层首次下行几乎必然且均值有限；依次跨越n层，E[tau]=sum_(d=1)^n e_d。它不是从有限轨迹推断无限结果。

用正的二项计数尾和检验递推，可得

    e_d = [sum_(j=d)^n binom(n,j)] / binom(n-1,d-1)。

把d与n-d+1配对，两尾和相加为2^n，分母相同。因此

    H_n := E[tau] = 2^(n-1) sum_(k=0)^(n-1) 1/binom(n-1,k)。

对n>=2，H_n>=2^n。对n>=4，中间二项系数至少binom(n-1,2)，故

    1+1/(n-1) <= H_n/2^n
      <= 1+1/(n-1)+(n-4)/[(n-1)(n-2)]。

于是 H_n/2^n -> 1。原命令首次到达数恰为4tau。

可检验比较：n5最短20命令、均值512/3；n10最短40、均值299008/63；n20最短80、均值12936558936064/2909907；n40最短160、均值150847528379754337563312128/33393321606645。四例的最小空位峰值全部为6。

在恰好n轮内成功要求每个单元恰好被选一次，最短成功前缀有n!条，每条权重n^(-n)，故Pr(tau=n)=n!/n^n。预先指定每个单元只转换一次则在n轮完成，但那是另一控制律，不是改变同一随机过程的分析结果。无自环边界链有周期2；本轮不声称定时分布收敛到均匀。均匀分布是它的平稳分布。

该指数等待是到达一个指定关系构型的稀少性，不是证明物理能垒、玻璃态或一般混合时间指数大；更不意味着其他允许控制器也必须慢。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 5. BRC首次到达观察与长度矩扩展
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 5. BRC首次到达观察与长度矩扩展

有限词使用原CWM串联、重合，已命中路径按其首次命中长度停住；未命中路径继续推进。总权重满足

    sum_(k<=t) W(first_hit_at_k) + sum_d W(alive_at_t,d) = 1。

命中前缀不再延长，故其C是变长停止词的计数，不冒称全部固定长度n^t词。所需“到过目标”记录不能用末态代替：n=1时第一轮已到目标，第二轮又回原态，第二轮的末态目标概率为0而此前曾命中的概率为1。

为闭合有任意长游程的均值，本轮扩展原TOTAL观察为(W,M)，其中M=sum路径权重×路径长度。备选逐项相加，串联为

    (W,M) tensor (V,N) = (WV, MV+WN)。

总量l<1、长度矩m的游程星闭包为

    (S, m S^2)， S=1/(1-l)。

S由原one_state_recurrent_cwm实际求得；其他非负系数计算使用原CWM的TOTAL读出。计数C和最大支路M不被错误赋给无限路径族；此处一阶长度矩使用独立类型Jet.L以区别CWM.dominant。无限闭包上的人工一条汇总环只是TOTAL入口，不是原微观游程只有一条。

对每个有限截点t还核对精确余额公式

    E[tau] = sum_(k<=t) k W(first_hit_at_k)
           + t W(alive_at_t)
           + sum_d W(alive_at_t,d) h_d，

其中h_d为从距离d到目标的剩余均值。它保留了尚未完成的重量，而不是靠截断后归一化伪报恢复。

实际检查了n=1..40与n=100的精确矩及整数证书；n=1,2,3,5,10,20的有限首次到达分布至4/24/48/100/200/300轮；n<=6的完整分组转移与距离压缩连续12轮逐CWM对照。n20在300轮（1200条原命令）内命中概率约0.000239008654634474，完整分数随结果保存。

本轮只计算上述明确控制律。一般资源-截止观察可记R(b,T)=W{首次命中<=T且路径峰值<=b}；使用带目标到达标记和峰值分层的原BRC组合即可。它是原过程的联合路径事件，不等于把超预算提案改成等待后的另一动力学。本文实际执行的控制路径峰值始终6，未宣称完成任意未知原生核的R计算。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 6. 接到已有U20：观察目标越细，返回义务不同
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 6. 接到已有U20：观察目标越细，返回义务不同

实际读取Source当前固定版U20 RESULT.md，路径research_notes/chatgpt_direct/20261010_cell_u20_mobile_junction_b4e8c1/RESULT.md，blob b5634a36d09b8e564fd6a545e92d0eb6a7035620。它报告相对状态链正再生、平稳权重lambda^L/Z；最低L3族A有N=11616个完整状态，每个权重lambda^3。下述是以这些既有模型结论为前提的新推论，不是本轮重跑或独立验证U20。

Kac返回恒等式给出，对任何具体s in A：

    E_s tau_s^+ = Z/lambda^3；
    E_(pi conditioned on A) tau_A^+ = Z/(11616 lambda^3)。

因此两种返回义务的均值比准确为11616。第二种初始分布是A上的平稳条件分布，由等权性恰为A上均匀分布；不是从任意初态到A的命中时间，也不是离开A之后才开始计时。两者均包含等待造成的一步返回。

在lambda=1/48，沿原TOTAL正闭包重建其报告中的Z上界343/729及A总权121/1152，于是

    E_(uniform A) tau_A^+ <= 43904/9801；
    11616 <= E_s tau_s^+ <= 1404928/27。

“经常回到某个最短关系状态”不能替代“迅速恢复某个指定完整关系”。这项条件推论已使用原BRC系数和有理观察证书执行；U20的258标签动力学、材料资源轨迹和原141545检查未在本轮运行。

U20依然是模型研究，并未提供自然三元力准入或物理时钟；本推论不提高其证据等级。

entries.title: 关系修复器自身的故障：私有输入记录、写入范围与首次逻辑失守
entries.summary_zh: 同轮私有输入快照和局部输出范围使至多一故障通道后仍至少两份正确；共享决定或边写边读可把单故障扩成全错。净独立噪声与原命令写入模型分别定型；两可恢复态的正BRC首次失守均值不是首轮错误概率倒数。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 1. 本轮对象和已声明的操作接口
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 1. 本轮对象和已声明的操作接口

前轮在准确比较器下纠正三份关系中的一个受损副本，同时给出读错后误修的反例。本轮检验修复器的读取、判断和写入故障能否限制在一个输出副本内。继续使用 L={123,456}、R={124,356}，以及原 reserve/release 写定词 W0、W1。固定源资料 RESULT blob 1b7b470f32c4f55698b1965f0a3d0cf4c530328b 已与当前 Source 比对；上传包20项文件先完整验证，只导入依赖，不运行任何旧 main。

数据为三个已饱和关系位 x=(x0,x1,x2)。一个修复轮次先保持数据不变，为每个输出通道保存三份私有输入读数，然后各自形成一个决定，最后只写自己的输出副本。新控制能力仍是显式的关系读取、多数比较、阶段选择和固定地址写入；不把它们宣称为原生三元力。每个可保存的输入位和决定都使用相同六成员 L/R 寄存器，不将寄存器值藏在一个免费的永久可靠标量内。

执行载体共15个寄存器：3数据、9私有输入、3私有决定，共90个发生标识。写入某寄存器实际调用原四命令；九次保存、三次决定写入、三次数据提交共60条命令；若另把12个工作寄存器写回标准 L，则再用48条命令，总108条。所有写入串行完成，已饱和寄存器间的临时空位至多6。比较动作的物理实现、传输距离、工作寄存器准备、地址隔离及阶段控制仍是接口条件，未由90个标识或这些命令数推出能量或物理时钟。

每个通道的有限故障模型有5个二值标志：三次读/复制可能各自翻错、一项私有比较结果翻错、一项最终完整写入翻错。每个故障只影响本通道的私有记录和自己的输出地址。遗漏、写成部分三元状态、地址逃逸、数据在保存阶段变化、全局阶段失控、共同供给或广播故障不是这份二值模型已经验证的故障集合。原检查器的 original 标签只作审计，不传给控制器。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 2. 一个故障通道不再把可恢复输入变成不可恢复输出
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 2. 一个故障通道不再把可恢复输入变成不可恢复输出

令原关系值为 b，初始 x 中至少两位等于 b。若最多一个通道发生任意多个本通道故障，其余通道准确读取同一初始 x、正确决定且仅写自己的副本，则完整轮次结束后至少两位仍为 b。

证明：每个健康通道都对同一 x 求多数，得到 b；它的输出无法被另一个通道的允许写入改变。至少两个健康通道，因此至少两个正确输出。这个结论不需要故障独立或已知概率。无故障时三输出全部为 b；一通道故障时保证的是仍可恢复，不是已经完整回到 bbb。下一次无故障轮次可以恢复 bbb。若没有额外数据扰动、且每轮的故障范围仍至多一通道，该边界不变量可以逐轮归纳；并不据此允许额外的跨通道噪声。

完整执行8种二值输入、3个故障通道、该通道32种故障组合，共768例。它们包含所有在三位重复码中距其多数值至多一位的输入。逐命令检查固定发生库存、事件许可、其余寄存器不变、原 BRC 串联以及临时空位。额外检查一个非平凡故障实例的全部6种提交顺序。

具体同源见证：x=001（左到右依次为通道0、1、2），原值0。通道0把第一份读错，看成101，决定1；其余通道读001，决定0。私有记录方案最后得到100：不是完美码字，但原0仍可从两份正确记录恢复。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 3. 私有输出与同轮输入记录是两项不同条件
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 3. 私有输出与同轮输入记录是两项不同条件

共享决定反例：同一个 x=001，只有共享比较器把第一份读错，决定1；随后把同一个决定写给全部三份，得到111。一次共享故障影响三个输出，不能按一次私有通道故障计数。

边写边读反例：三条通道虽各自比较、各自只写自身，但第一条读错后将001写成101；第二条完全正确地读取当前101，写成111；第三条正确保持1。仍只有第一条判断发生错误，却扩散成全错。故输出范围隔离不自动消除时间上的反馈污染。

保持私有初始记录时，同样按0、1、2提交会经历数据边界001 ->101 ->101 ->100。第一项数据提交后，数据本身的多数已暂时错误，但健康通道的两个待提交决定仍明确保存为0。最终保证不能提升为每个原命令前缀的数据保护；完整状态包括私有输入、决定和阶段。

同一个当前数据001和完全相同的全部占用，还可以带私有决定000或111；同样提交动作分别给出000或111。当前数据或总占用不能替代含控制器的完整状态。清理工作寄存器是一次真实多对一写入，不证明丢失的输入从未存在，也不承担尚未建立的热力学解释。

共同输入反例也已运行：第一份输入被同一个广播故障同时错误送到三通道，使三份私有记录都为101，最终仍111。复制次数不是故障域隔离的证明。本轮既未证明复制读数独立，也未假定一般晶胞中不存在共同原因。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 4. 完整读取/判断/写入噪声的精确比较
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 4. 完整读取/判断/写入噪声的精确比较

先给一个便于辨认的净故障模型：每轮数据各位以 epsilon 独立翻转，随后每条私有通道以 q 独立把多数目标写反；对照结构则以 q 把一个共享目标写反并广播。原噪声来源按正 CWM 备选保留，权重仅附一次。q 是净通道故障率，不是每条四命令都以 q 故障。

记 g(t)=3t^2(1-t)+t^3。首次从000开始，私有结构的逻辑多数错误为 (1-g(epsilon))*g(q)+g(epsilon)*(1-g(q))；共享结构为 (1-g(epsilon))*q+g(epsilon)*(1-q)。两结构每一个输出副本的错误率都为 (1-g(epsilon))*q+g(epsilon)*(1-q)。单份可靠性相同，联合可靠性不同。

在 epsilon=q=1/100 时：私有逻辑错误0.000595822392，共享0.01029204，每份边缘错误都为0.01029204。没有新数据错误时（epsilon=0），私有逻辑错误 g(q)，共享 q。这是复制判断的经典组合机制在原关系寄存器接口中的应用，不宣称新发明多数公式。

再使用更细的模型：每次输入读/复制错误1%、每次比较结果错误1%、每次最终完整写入错误1%，且轮次之间每份数据错误1%；全部这些指定位置独立。私有结构具有9次独立读、3次独立决定故障、3次独立写故障；共享结构有3次共同读、1次共同决定故障和3次独立写故障。两者读取同一受扰数据，因此混合初态后不再假定输出互相独立。

对固定输入 y，先枚举单通道32种故障，再按真实条件输入的通道乘积组合。共享结构先枚举16种共享读/决定故障，再组合8种写故障。八种数据噪声在此前加入。原正 BRC 计数、TOTAL和最大单支路分别保留。对数据错误数 k 的压缩在本固定、置换对称核及首次逻辑失守观察下保持有限 C/W/M；不能复用于指定成员或工作记录查询。

细模型从000开始的精确结果为：
- 每份输出错误率两者完全相同：3267911819601/156250000000000，约2.0914635645%。
- 私有结构首次轮次逻辑错误约0.1584232498%。
- 共享结构首次轮次逻辑错误约1.1428745431%。

有限错误族的笛卡尔积有精确的分解和条件独立来源；不是从相同边缘分布猜出联合律。768次原编译覆盖单通道映射的所有32标志；概率计算复用该证明后的乘积，而不声称所有2^15个故障向量都逐个执行了60命令。共同噪声或错误读控地址会改变以上结果。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 5. 重复运行时，首次错误概率的倒数不是一般寿命
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 5. 重复运行时，首次错误概率的倒数不是一般寿命

轮次末态有0、1、2、3份错误。从0或1份错误出发算尚未逻辑失守，首次到达2或3份算失败；这是每次完整提交边界的观察，不是中途数据读出、物理死亡或全部关系不可逆丢失。每轮继续携带上一轮真实状态，不插入额外完美修复。

令 Q_ij（i,j属于{0,1}）为仍在可恢复域内的转移总量，b_i为当轮离开该域的总量。平均首次失守次数满足 h_i=1+Q_i0*h_0+Q_i1*h_1。实际求解不以普通矩阵逆代替BRC：令每条边带(TOTAL,长度矩)=(p,p)，S1=(Q11)*，F0=star(Q00+Q01*S1*Q10) * (b0+Q01*S1*b1)，F1=S1*(b1+Q10*F0)。所有串联与备选使用继承TOTAL/Jet；星闭包实际调用原one_state_recurrent_cwm。每一有限命中路径有唯一的游程分解，得总量1及有限长度矩。

对上述每个细故障位置均1%的模型，从000开始平均首次失守轮数：私有约336.75838869；共享约80.06835663。不是把0.158423%的倒数当作私有寿命，因为一次修复可能留下1份错误，使后轮更容易失守。

净故障模型 epsilon=q=1%给私有约857.98009253、共享约97.16246730；epsilon=0,q=1%则分别为500000/149和100。不同噪声定义不可混用。这些轮次具有不同电路工作量，不能声称等物理时间、等材料或等总操作成本的优势。

每种核从完整8状态推进100轮，与错误数商逐CWM比较。首次命中词停止，未命中词继续，每层核对已命中TOTAL+存活TOTAL=1，以及已耗长度矩+存活已耗轮数+精确剩余均值=无限首次失守均值。输出同时保留0错误和1错误的存活分布，没有把未完成/受阻分支删掉后重新归一化。

formula_result_and_scope_extracts.heading: ## 6. 证据、先例和下一接口
formula_result_and_scope_extracts.text:
## 6. 证据、先例和下一接口

本轮253981项新检查，原操作调用46992次，778个完整协议实例，11748个四命令写定块；BRC edge15675/propagate87298/recoalesce38126，TOTAL/Jet星闭包13次，调用中的继承辅助检查16项。两个最终独立进程PYTHONHASHSEED=0/97的results、summary与日志逐字相同；同作者复验，不是独立数学审核。完整结果2606201字节，SHA256 33173d9ce9241534f12dc4bf27135bb1e32db63dbc4536c29ae27e2aa27a956f。完整代码、固定依赖、代表性原操作轨迹、精确概率及校验清单见 residual_fault_containment.zip；本Source报告自足保存证明和结果，不称该目录独立安装全部依赖。

来源依赖：check_memory.py SHA256 e17ea5f3d955b2054ce38f8139631b518378ef25cb6b96fe38c00309a3ae7a43；reset SHA256 548ab79cd9ba8d26d67a2807383f401a254e48d19b38347cd47e584b7a9a074a；kinetic SHA256 1505c782683a4236db262a26553065692337402dd5eaf453db011ab06fd308ae；exchange blob f45165d7144d342d6cf9233ea77a04a51d2b96e3；membership blob be1b60446e31c2c8489d1ce0db16cc1e952d11c8；BRC blob 3f205696709e847909958a153f8fe10d3f6b70f0。原函数未改，继承BRC载入器的两项未用相对import处理保持原状。

三模冗余及多数器复制有既有先例，NASA NTRS 19880045603（Kiskis/Shin, 1988）公开摘要描述复制计算及表决过程以屏蔽单点故障。Mozeika/Saad, On reliable computation by noisy random Boolean formulas, arXiv1206.4851v2，题录摘要研究噪声多数型门与可靠计算。仅核读这些公开原始来源的摘要，不借未读全文的阈值或硬件结论。专用查询3733/batch6df8f278-34be-4dbe-bff1-7b8bef143b67已匹配db6caf6c92e88a64a385c81720c6065147bfbe312dbe4af43aa107a3ed1e2cc0，双层COMPLETED、retrieval_verified=true，返回一篇题录摘要；原结果comment6108523713，上游总量未知。

P000、六轴PERP_E、120度和既定平方和没有改变。当前Sites检查只读；研究活动、PRE_FINAL与独立审核未取得。新研究保存不恢复旧被拒写入，不授予Task/CLAIM或原生力学准入。

下一问题是将通道影响范围本身纳入来源明确的材料/场/支撑规则：一次局部故障最多影响几份保存值、哪些共享输入或阶段资源会跨通道传导，以及本轮输入保持如何实现。已证明的条件修复不自动证明独立故障域或免费快照。要继续计算真实单轴响应，须把这些真实读写范围接入六轴读出；不能把90个发生标识改名为六轴。
